programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳 II之父子情仇
programme.desc: Lee Rock realizes the promotion is indeed the manoeuvre of his surrender of power. So he decides it is the right time to resign. His son, Yin, has graduated and joins the ICAC...

programme.title: 靈幻先生
programme.desc: One dark night, a charlatan Uncle Ming attempts to exorcise angry spirits in a haunted house but is unsuccessful and he narrowly escapes. He brings his two ghostly companions Ta Pao and Hsi Pao with him to a nearby town. The town is under attack by a group of bandits with supernatural powers. The thugs are led by Devil Lady, a powerful evil witch doctor. When Ming and the Paos are having dinner in a restaurant, Captain Chiang comes to harass them, and the Paos take revenge by playing tricks on Chiang. Just then, Chiang's master, Uncle Nine, appears and he subdues the two ghosts and traps them inside a wine jar. Ming pleads with Nine to release the Paos. Nine agrees to set the ghosts free but warns Ming that he must part ways with them, but Ta Pao is captured by Devil Lady later due to Chiang's act of mischief..

programme.title: 皇家女將
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..

programme.title: 衛斯理之霸王卸甲
programme.desc: This is a film about one of the practical metaphysics of the Orient - Geomancy. The Orientals believe fervently that a good burial site endows fame and fortune on its descendants. When the story begins, two geomancers are roaming Indochina's wilderness trying to find the dream grave site. They find The Conqueror, a site generating wealth and power - also a bloodbath. Nguen wants it but Wei wants no bloodbath. They have a fight. Wei escapes by the skin of his teeth. Wei rewards the poor man who saved him by finding him a good grave site. Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler. The girl asks him to go to Indochina to trace their roots..

programme.title: 安娜瑪德蓮娜
programme.desc: A romantic tale about 3 young people who starts out as adversaries and blossoms into something else. When a gorgeous female moves into the building and 2 men fall in love with her.

programme.title: 我家有一隻河東獅
programme.desc: During Soong dynasty, there lived a beauty named Moth Liu. She has gone to blind dates for many times. Still she cannot get married, until she meets a talented poet Seasonal Chan. Seasonal is making his debut as Soo's special guest in a reading-concert, his avant-garde style is badly received, only Moth supports him whole heatedly. Not long afterwards the two get married, and only until then Seasonal realizes that he has married to a roaring lion who limits him on all his activities and expenses..

programme.title: 龍鳳智多星
programme.desc: Taiwanese detective Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger..

programme.title: 金像匠人: 江湖龍虎鬥
programme.desc: Wing and Fat have the same burning ambition to be big in the underworld. They struggle and are doing very well, so well the kingpin of the gangs wants to get rid of them. Wing and Fat are forced to fight back, then the showdown comes..

programme.title: 福星高照
programme.desc: Two Hong-Kong cops are sent to Tokyo to catch an ex-cop who stole a large amount of money in diamonds. After one is captured by the Ninja-gang protecting the rogue cop, the other one gets his old Orphanage gang, dubbed the 'Five Lucky Stars,' to help him. They don't like this much, but they do it..

programme.desc: Personal and interest conflicts between two garage owners Ken and Jim along with Ken's four young men staffs and Jim's four young girl helpers make them compete with each other..

programme.desc: The lucky stars reunite again. Having the new members joined in, they are playful and frolicsome as usual. This time, their mission is to investigate a case of international ammunition trade that involves two gangs. One is the Japanese underworld society that holds many stolen diamonds, and another one is the mysterious terrorists who own an enormous amount of ammunition. Let's see how the lucky stars overcome the danger and problem.

programme.title: 賭俠2之上海灘賭聖
programme.desc: Coming back learning from the God of Gambler, Star accidentally falls into a time tunnel and back to Shanghai in 1937, where he meets his grandfather Fook, Yvonne and Danny..

programme.title: 笑傲江湖
programme.desc: The Sunflower Manuscript that contains martial arts secrets is stolen from the Forbidden City. Head eunuch, Koo Kam-fook, suspects Lam Chun-nam of the theft, so he sends officer Chuen and his men to the Lam dyeing factory to investigate and kill Lam and his son, Ping-chi. Before Lam dies, he whispers to Ling Wu-chung and his schoolmate Ngok Ling-shan where he has hidden the manuscript, so that Chung can tell his son, who is not at the factory. Chung and Shan begin their trip to return to Mount Wah and meet Kwan, who is Chung's master and Shan's father. However, Chuen has already killed Chi and assumed his identity..

programme.title: 蜀山傳
programme.desc: Between the heaven and the Earth exist the Zu's mountain range, where live the immortals of Omei, the highest mountain of Zu, but the kingdom is in danger by Amnesia..

programme.title: 神偷次世代
programme.desc: Mac, a professional thief, and three others organize commercial thieves together. While stealing a cancer vaccine, they find a pre-set bomb which it is a setup against them..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 流氓師表
programme.desc: Mildly entertaining low-budget quickie that basically rips off Great Teacher Onizuka with less drama and a much less appealing lead actor. Nick Cheung is a triad who's hired by old classmate Lo May to teach a class of reprobates.

programme.title: 半支煙
programme.desc: Killer Leopard, diagnosed as having Alzheimer's Disease, returns to Hong Kong with a half cigarette, to meet his beloved woman for the last time..

programme.title: 辣手回春
programme.desc: This is the first day of work for Yan at Sir Kau Kei Ho Charity Hospital's A&E. Yan is shocked to find that Jim, teaching her shedding job responsibility. An old man is taken to A&E after being struck by lightening. Each department dispatches him to one another but scrambling to take him after knowing that he is Ho Kau Kei. Ho wants to abolish the hospital's bureaucratic system, by appointing Yan, together with Joe and Jim to make changes by their own ways..

programme.title: 慈禧秘密生活
programme.desc: The last empress of China, CHI HEI, had dominated the country for over fifty years. Yet, her rise to power owned much to her manipulation of her beauty and sexual appeal. Prior to becoming one of the three thousand concubines chosen to serve the emperor. CHI met KUNG, younger brother of the Emperor; and they fell in love with each other. However, KUNG fled from the relationship to avoid conflicts with his brother. In order to stand out from other concubines, CHI racked her brains to design numerous creative and exciting “on-bed tricks” for the Emperor, who madly enjoyed their lovemaking. After she bore him a son, she became the first lady..

programme.title: 雌雄大盜
programme.desc: An armed couple breaks in the venue of the world-renowned jewelry designer Yamamoto's exhibition in Tokyo and takes away the most valuable pieces on display. The robbery ends in bloodshed. Inspector Fujioka's assistant is shot to death at the crime scene. The couple takes the jewelry to Hong Kong and Fujioka follows their trail. Madam Yang of the Hong Kong Police is assigned to help him. However, Yang's superior and uncle intervenes the investigation. Fujioka is tired of such power struggle and decides to act on his own accord..

programme.title: 兩個只能活一個
programme.desc: Mo is a low-life gangster, who dreams of a better life. He sees his chance when he's promised a $88,000 fee to commit a murder. However, the day before the assassination is meant to take place, Mo bets all his money at a casino, and wins a fortune..

programme.title: 英雄好漢
programme.desc: Lee Ah Chai, a native Chiu Chow, a province of China. He was married with children of his own. He was rich, powerful and influential and he was the leading man in the underworld, virtually to as the ‘Big Boss'. But he was unhappy. After spending so many years involving with vice and crime, he was sick of this world and wanted to start his life anew. Some ten years ago, Chai had two side-kicks, Tang Kar Yung and Chan Ting Kok. Kok was adopted by Uncle Cut, the father of Yung. The two boys were raised up together and they were like brothers, if not by blood. But a misconception broke out which overshadowed the relationship amongst the three of them. It led Chai and Yung to divergence and the fight of Kok to Malacca..

programme.title: 秋天的童話
programme.desc: Lee Kay goes to college in New York City and also to visit her boyfriend Dickson. The one to meet her at the airport is a distant relative Boat Head..

programme.title: 三人做世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex and Chu Lai Ngo, played by George Lam and Do Do Cheng, finally get married and live with Chu's daughter Vivian, played by Vivian Chow. Since the owner of the advertising company migrates, Alex starts to take control of the company. However, the company is forced to close down due to the banker goes bankrupt. Besides, Chu and Vivian both join a financial investment company owned by Alex's old classmate ET, acted by Paul Chun. Chu is promoted to be the Assistant of General Manager in a short period of time. Nevertheless, it is a fraud for Chu. Can Alex save his company from closing down and how does Alex help Chu run away from the fraud..

programme.title: 跛豪
programme.desc: The story of Ho, a chinese peasant/slave worker who escapes to Hong Kong and becomes one of the most feared crime bosses in Hong Kong.

programme.title: 富貴再逼人
programme.desc: After he lost his chance of winning easy money in the original film, Bill became an editor for a newspaper and was sent to Canada for a story. What he thought was a chance to re-launch his career turned out to be a reason to get him fired. Just when the family has settled back down in Hong Kong, Bill's wife realized she has won the lottery in Canada..

programme.title: 富貴再三逼人
programme.desc: In the third installment of this comedy hit, Bill and his wife have become snobbish after they won the lottery in Canada. When they showed off their money at the bank to their friends, they lost it all during a bank robbery and had to move back to their small flat in the public housing estate. When Bill went for an audition at the TV station, he ran into his ex-girlfriend and got himself into trouble when his wife thought he was having an affair. Later, Bill was notified by the bank that they will be reimbursed for the money they lost in the robbery due to a security breach of the bank..

programme.title: 龍兄虎弟
programme.desc: Jackie assists the Duke for his exploration of the armour. In his latest hunt, he succeeded to acquire the 'sacred sword'. The terrorists kidnapped his friend in exchange..

programme.title: 野獸之瞳
programme.desc: Twin brothers Tan and Tide had been fought for the best until Tan died. Tide investigates the death and meets Tan's lover Sandy. Tide finds himself being attracted to her warmth..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: 生死線
programme.desc: The story takes place on a deserted island. The only residence on the island is a family in which the mother ruled over three of her sons: Tai Fat, gloomy and sullen; Yee Fat, vulgar and cruel; Sam Fat, slightly retarded. Mother's earnest wish is to find a wife for Sam Fat to continue the family tree. Teacher Cheung, along with six of his students arrive on the island for camping. They first meet Yee Fat who brings them to the grocery for a rest. Yee Fat is delighted with the presence of the 3 young girls while Sam Fat falls in love at first sight with the charming girl Phyllis. He expresses his feelings to Tai Fat who has sworn to his mother that he will fulfill her wish to find his youngest brother a wife. He proposes to Cheung that Phyllis be married to Sam Fat. Cheung first thinks that it's a joke, but soon senses that Tai Fat is serious and that all three brothers are actually psychologically imbalanced..

programme.title: 龍在江湖
programme.desc: Cheung Dee, together with his best friends Long Life Chuen and Holy Sand, set up a valet parking counter outside a restaurant owned by a triad society he affiliates with. By accident, Cheung finds out that the son of his triad head, Tai Tze, is fiercely attacked by Song Bo. To save Tai's life, Cheung attacks Song and not only leaves a scar on Song's face, but also puts him in jail for five years which plants a seed of the revenge five years later. Form that moment, the only person that can cheer him up is his best girl friend Ruby. Yet, Cheung has his heart on Sandy, a young solicitor who helped set him free in an assault case. No sooner has their love relationship developed than Cheung's nightmare has begun.....

programme.title: Office有鬼
programme.desc: In every lunar July, there would be nine persons died in this building and no one knows the reason. Ken came to this building for interview. He saw several ladies talking about ghost story in the lobby. Amongst the ladies, he found his old girlfriend, Pat and another attractive girl who was wearing a red dress..

programme.title: 跛豪
programme.desc: The story of Ho, a chinese peasant/slave worker who escapes to Hong Kong and becomes one of the most feared crime bosses in Hong Kong.

programme.title: 富貴再逼人
programme.desc: After he lost his chance of winning easy money in the original film, Bill became an editor for a newspaper and was sent to Canada for a story. What he thought was a chance to re-launch his career turned out to be a reason to get him fired. Just when the family has settled back down in Hong Kong, Bill's wife realized she has won the lottery in Canada..

programme.title: 東方三俠
programme.desc: The evil minions of an ancient eunuch are stealing baby boys from their hospital cribs. The only hope to save the city is in the hands of The Heroic Trio.

programme.title: 虎度門
programme.desc: Lang Kim Sang, a famous Cantonese Opera actress, strives to revitalize the traditional art. She hires a new director but stirs up resentment and jealousy within the troupe..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻三之獅王爭霸
programme.desc: Chit the Kick breaks his leg in the fight with Wong Fey Hong, and is discarded by godfather Chao. Wong nurses him and teams up with him in a martial arts tournament to defeat Chao..

programme.title: 八彩林亞珍
programme.desc: Jenny, with the plain looks but a heart of gold, she is always in between jobs. Once she gets a job, her knack of creating awkward situations immediately loses it for her. Fang is her suitor, but he gets nowhere as the girl has no time for love, so Fang goes along with her in job hunting. A big group called Sanda wants to take over the whole city through take-over deals. They are ruthless and have thrown thousands into the streets. Jenny and Fang, bungling as they are, become the vanguard of a movement against the great conglomerate. They were even being hunted by the group and their life was threatened..

programme.title: 冒險王
programme.desc: “The Scripture With No Words” had been lost for a long time. Everybody was eager to find it, even the ambitious Japanese. Dr. Wai was antiquarian. Having seen the mysterious “Wooden Horse”, lost control and killing people, he quit his job. However, being supported by his friend, Dr. Wai recovered and resumed to his work. He went to Shanghai trying to locate “The Scripture With No Words” and he discovered that it was in the possession of the leader of “Gang of Salt”. And the game begin..

programme.title: 夏日福星
programme.desc: Muscles, Kidstuff, Fung, and the gang taking a well-needed vacation in Thailand courtesy of the Hong Kong police department. Also on the trip is police inspector Woo on orders to track down a list of drug dealers from informant Ma. Unfortunately, Ma gets whacked by a Thai crime lord, but he tells Woo as he draws his last breath that he mailed the list to his friend in Hong Kong. Meanwhile, Muscles and the gang are shaking down Lau, a drug dealer who, it turns out, is being targeted by the same baddies that killed Ma..

programme.title: 黑馬王子
programme.desc: Wah is an unkempt, uneducated and undiplomatic guy who is doomed to be a loser of love. Bok Ping is a stylish Shanghai girl with a tycoon father. But Bok Ping decides to go to Hong Kong to seek her mother, who has departed from her when she was a child. She encounters Wah in the process and lives a simple life with Wah's mother. Wah, being influenced by Bok Ping, becomes more polite and cultured. Meanwhile, Bok Ping's father deems that Wah has kidnapped his daughter, but unexpectedly, Bok Ping has really been kidnapped..

programme.title: 唐伯虎點秋香
programme.desc: Tong Park Foo is the top-grade scholar in Suzhou. On a feast day, Tong and his friends go to visit the temple and there, Tong meets Chau Heung for the first time. Tong is shaken at Chau's beauty. He decides to go after her. But Chau's master Mrs. Wah is very angry with Tong's family, how can Tong make Chau Heung his bride.

programme.title: 四人新世界
programme.desc: Fei is the master cook in Hong Kong, while his son Suckling has established himself as a real estate salesman in Canada. Suckling sends for his father to join him in this new chapter of their lives. Happily, Fei hops on a plane to Canada. During the flight, he has the good fortune of meeting Yim Chau, a young woman traveling to join her aunt in Canada. Subsequently, Fei meets Yim Chau's aunt and Suckling meets Yim Chau. Suckling loves Yim Chau but is too shy to express his feelings. When Yim Chau announces she falls in love with Richard, Suckling feels heartbroken but still helps her with dating preparations. However, when he discovers Richard cheating her, Suckling fights him. At the same time, he is being chased by the bank for debts..

programme.title: 五個寂寞的心
programme.desc: This is a story about five sixteen years old girls...Yan, Celia, Maggie, Jacky and Kitty are five close friends, they live and study together. During their growing process, all of them have their own confusion. Yan meets Wai accidentally and being love with each other. Kitty is unhappy with her brother's new girlfriend, she wants to separate them then cause many incidents..

programme.title: 戀上你的床
programme.desc: Carrie left Raymond not because he had too many other women, but only because he slept with another woman right on the bed Carrie has always been obsessed with. After the break up, she begged for ownership of the bed she's gotten used to. Carrie was assigned to follow the story of city's celebrated super cop, Paul Ko. While exchanging fire he was shot at by an AK-47 and become a sexual impotent. During the process of interviewing, Carrie has fallen to Paul. Raymond is being considered for a promotion to district court, his superiors request for him to stay away from the night-life and women. In the thick of this difficult celibate period, an 18 year old girl called Tabby barges into Raymond's life..

programme.desc: With a box of worthless war bonds, an old man hired the King of Killers to assassinate a Japanese trade lord. In WWII, the trade lord's action had caused grave damage to the family of the King of Killers. He agrees to take the job and delivers in a few days. The Revenge Fund set up by the trade lord kicks in. Whoever avenges the trade lord's death, killing the killer and the force behind him, will receive a reward of $1 billion. The police assigns Inspector to watch the killers, with orders to leave them room when they kill each other. Among the killers vying for the reward are Fu, a new immigrant, and his agent, Wong a longtime loser trying to score a big one riding on Fu's coat-tail. After an elaborately orchestrated chain of events, Wong and Fu manage to accomplish their goal.

programme.title: 無限復活
programme.desc: Ren takes out his entire savings and persuades his best friend Sing to leave for Vegas with him. They challenge the most well respected dealer in town, and in just one round, Ren's wages is all wiped out. Ren and Sing begin their trip back to LA, but on the way their car mysteriously overturns and crashes, Sing is dead. Ren arrives home wearily to find a message on his answering machine that warns him not to go to Vegas. He decides to go back to Vegas to find out what really happened that killed Sing..

programme.title: 監獄風雲
programme.desc: The plot mostly involves the two main characters, Ching and Yiu and problems they face with Mickey, a fellow inmate and “Scarface”, a high-ranking officer. Yiu is sentenced to three years for manslaughter. In a fight for his father, he kicked a man onto the path of a bus. Ching was sent to prison for killing his wife for being a prostitute. During the end of the film, inmates decide to go on hunger strike to protest against the cigarette price rise, this causes problems with “Assassin”. Ching bit “Scarface”‘s ear off and gets an extended sentence, Yiu is released from the prison.

programme.title: 監獄風雲II之逃犯
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat plays a veteran inmate Chung Tin Ching. When serving his term, Ching's mother passed away his son is sent to an orphanage. When his application for leave is turned down, he breaks out of prison, further antagonizing the new Head of Security, played by Tsui Kam Kong. Chen Sung Yung plays a fellow inmate from the Mainland, Lung who befriends Ching. When he is framed for murder, Ching is implicated in fingering him. Ching and Lung must break out of prison to stay alive..

programme.desc: Bill and Lee are a pair of old hands working with the Action Squad in the Police Department. They both have their shortcomings. Unfortunately for them, a Pl Mak is newly appointed as their squad leader. To make matter worse, the new inspector is female. programme.desc: A self-obsessed man, desperately seeking his true identity, York plays carelessly with his lovers and his friends before leaving them all to the Philippines in search of the truth..

programme.desc: Andy is a seasoned motor-cycle driver. His ultimate goal is to enroll in Grand Prix Racing. But in a private race, a severe crash almost took Andy's life..

Raymond is so involved with Siu Hung that he decides to take Sylvia on a trip to Singapore to bring back the memory. As their relationships unfold, long-dormant romantic instincts are awakened in this refreshingly daring dating reality show.

programme.desc: Two-day road trip to the beautiful spots in all the corners of Korea! Instead of fancy studio, this on-the-road reality show takes place in the rural sides. While over 10 million Koreans travel abroad each year, the '2 Days and 1 Night' casts travel around Korea - to the mountains, farms, fishing villages, islands - where you can meet the welcoming smiles of our neighbors and the beautiful nature that cleanse our eyes.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Space Farmers 第1季
programme.desc: Space foods, initially created just for astronauts, has now facilitated a revolution in agricultural and alternative food production. This revolution is changing the way we think about producing food in the future. In Finland, protein-rich foods are produced from thin air, making food production possible in a variety of environments, including deserts, cities, and even outer space. Scientists in the United States are working to make mushroom cultivation more sustainable, while in Austria, seeds are exposed to space radiation to improve their yield when grown back on Earth. A startup in Singapore is using space technology to enhance the security of livestock herds, and at NUS, a team has developed a remarkable hydrogel that makes crop cultivation more water-efficient.

programme.title: Space Farmers 第1季
programme.sub-title: Food For Space Helps Planet Earth
programme.desc: How will research to live in space in the future benefit us on Earth today? In the Netherlands, we meet a team of researchers working with Martian and Lunar soil to grow crops and mealworms as food. In Thailand, scientists test the effects of varying gravity on the next superfood - watermeal. Meanwhile, an astounding transformation of agriculture is underway in Australia, with crop cultivation methods increasing output by 100%. With a cultivated beef firm in Israel racing to grow meat in space and a Singaporean company using microalgae to produce protein-rich foods, we learn how less is more for food production. Inspired by the similarity between disaster areas and outer space, a Japanese entrepreneur creates jellies to provide nutrition to earthquake victims and astronauts. As the space industry in Singapore grows, collaborations between countries and students’ interests in outer space deepen, leading to a transformation in space-for-humanity research.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: In the penultimate stretch of their journey, the four remaining celebrities must find and eat the fruits of the forest, carefully separating nutritious treats from any potentially deadly dinners. Bear also tests their ability to start a fire using only bamboo poles, knives and flints, before deciding which three he will take through to the Bear Grylls: Mission Survive final.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: The final three contestants Kelly Holmes, Mike Tindall and Vogue Williams fight it out to be crowned Bear's Mission Survivor. It’s an uplifting and life-affirming watch as this unique presenter reveals how he takes constant pleasure from the smallest things in rugged landscapes as beautiful as this.

programme.title: Heavy Load 第1季第4集 -A 300 ton-Journey
programme.desc: Super heavy, super high and super wide. Autoclaves are the names of the metal giants in which aircraft parts are to be produced from a wide variety of materials under extreme pressure and heat. But it is a long and dangerous way to get there. The two autoclaves weigh over 300 tonnes and have to be transported over a distance of 100 kilometres. A challenge that is anything but easy and involves many risks and hurdles. It is a single obstacle course. From overhead cables hanging too low at level crossings, to bridges that cannot withstand the weight, to narrow roads and steep inclines. And all this in miserable weather and slush. It is a battle for centimetres, there's not a second to lose attention, not an obstacle to be overlooked.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -神祕失蹤的小貓案件
programme.desc: When Mr. Tiggles goes missing, Addison must figure out if this is just a matter of a cat stuck in a tree, or a nefarious kitty kidnapping conspiracy.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -打噴嚏鼻塞之謎
programme.desc: When Mrs. Rorschach suddenly develops an allergy, every indictor points to Mr. Tiggles as the cause. Addison has to solve the mystery before Mrs. Rorschach and her kitty are forced to part ways forever.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -鉛筆
programme.desc: After scribbling away, let's explore some fun DIY ideas.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -海綿
programme.desc: Let's get creative using a sponge and see what Hepi and Briko are up to.

programme.title: 優可 -最棒的恐龍
programme.desc: Yoko's magic transforms toy dinosaurs into real-live creatures, and the kids compete to figure out which dinosaur is best.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -長老鎮長
programme.desc: Senior is afraid that the citizens of Hill Town think that he is too old to be their mayor. He decides to embark on a perilous journey beneath the clouds to prove that he's still young and fresh, and he wants Sprinter to come with him.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -奧提要節食
programme.desc: Opti thinks that he's gotten too fat and Sprinter decides to help him lose weight. But it can be hard going on a diet when you share a body with someone who doesn't feel fat. So maybe the solution is something quite different.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -洋流
programme.desc: Exhausted, Kit lets the sea currents carry him north, while Mr. Battery would prefer to return to their home in the south.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -浮冰
programme.desc: Alone, Kit gets stranded in the freezing Arctic. Will he manage to make his way back to Mr. Battery at the spaceport.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -厄瓜多之旅
programme.desc: Zoe's avocado tree is not in good shape, and she doesn't know how to revive it. Our friends travel to Ecuador, where they meet Idzi. He has a fabulous garden and a particular way to tend it.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅, 第一部
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo do not seem to know that there is a place on Earth where it is not at all polite to open a present in front of the person that gave it to you. Alim suggests bringing his friends to Japan, where they meet Kimiko.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -摩洛哥之旅
programme.desc: Zoe is disgusted when she sees that Alim starts eating the chocolate mousse she prepared without a spoon. Soon after, they travel to Morocco and learn more about the eating customs there.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -奈及利亞之旅
programme.desc: Alim thinks that the criteria for being beautiful are not the same from country to country. To prove that beauty standards vary across cultures, he takes his friends to Nigeria, where, as they speak, a beauty contest is taking place.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇前進中國
programme.desc: Oto builds a tunnel-boring machine. Doki suggests they find out if what his grandma used to say is true: can we really dig a tunel to China? The boys set off on a journey to bore right into the Earth's crust, while the girls race them to Beijing, China in the plane.

programme.title: 叢林樂節拍 -大象--糟糕, 踩碎了
programme.desc: The elephant accidentally stands on a flower and is upset that he has crushed the innocent thing. He does everything he can to revive the flower, but things get worse before they get better. Welcome to the jungle where funny animals live and play.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -迷人的化石
programme.desc: Were all dinosaurs reptiles? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of palaeontology. Have hands-on fun by creating a dinosaur egg, and get to know Teuku Jacob, who used fossils and remains to study the origins and predecessors of present human species.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -點亮太陽系
programme.desc: What's the best way to remember the colours of the rainbow? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of light in space. Have hands-on fun by creating a kaleidoscope, and get to know Wang Zhenyi, who originated her own exact model of the solar system.

programme.title: 44隻貓 -飛行尋寶比賽
programme.desc: A “flying treasure hunt” is about to take place. Competitors have to move without ever touching the ground to reach the final treasure. Meatball is happy to compete, but will he manage to prove he is a real flying cat.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波和海怪
programme.desc: Granny reads to Flo about a local legendary sea monster. On the way home from Granny's, in the dinghy Ebb and Bird make a mysterious new friend who likes to play with Ebb's squeaky ball and seems to guard them all the way home.

programme.title: 百變小露露 -香蕉的種子
programme.desc: While planting Luna's bean sprout, the trio wonders what else could grow in the garden, like bananas. But where are banana seeds? Exploring the garden, they discover how new banana plants grow without seeds.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -終端速度
programme.desc: With their textbook back in hand, the group returns to their main mission of finding the secret lab – only to be stumped by the latest riddle. Joy proposes a solution that reveals a shocking secret from Raign's past.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -南瓜與巨龍
programme.desc: Rose accidentally turns Regal Academy into a pumpkin patch. The teachers need a rare colossal pumpkin to reverse the spell. With help from Alicia, Puss In Boots' granddaughter, Rose, Hawk, and the others must find the rare pumpkin to save the school.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -童年
programme.desc: Children of noble stock receive an education in a castle environment while peasant offspring spend their youth working in the fields or at home. Daily life is busy, from a very young age. But kids never forget to have fun and goof around or playing pranks on each other.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇前進中國
programme.desc: Oto builds a tunnel-boring machine. Doki suggests they find out if what his grandma used to say is true: can we really dig a tunel to China? The boys set off on a journey to bore right into the Earth's crust, while the girls race them to Beijing, China in the plane.

programme.title: 太摩和圖拉: 小小廚神 -杏仁冰淇淋
programme.desc: Telmo and Tula decide to mix almonds with ice to make a delicious ice cream.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -小丑魚與白虎
programme.desc: We follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more clownfish to come. In the meantime, Lin Mao, the white tiger, has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -冰島
programme.desc: Iceland winter adventure: Ice climbing and glacier walking, stunning sunset snowmobiling at a massive glacier. Cultural experience at a local hot spring with language lessons from Icelandic teens. Unforgettable icy escapades with Nicole.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -馬可島
programme.desc: Florida sunshine adventure: Waverunners with wild dolphins, airboat through the Everglades, glassblowing lesson testing focus, and soaring on a jetpack above the water. A week of thrilling escapades with Nicole and local teens in Marco Island.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -洋流
programme.desc: Exhausted, Kit lets the sea currents carry him north, while Mr. Battery would prefer to return to their home in the south.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -浮冰
programme.desc: Alone, Kit gets stranded in the freezing Arctic. Will he manage to make his way back to Mr. Battery at the spaceport.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -失蹤
programme.desc: The Nektons find the Dark Orca pirate submarine completely deserted! But why? And what are those mysterious, ghostly sounds.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -實際證明
programme.desc: Eric juggles three different kinds of balls: a baseball, a tennis ball, and a bouncy rubber ball. Then he does a scientific experiment to see which one can bounce the highest.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -異味
programme.desc: Something's wrong-and smelly-in town. It's Flippy, who hasn't showered in three weeks because of his new pets... lice! When the others find out, they'll do whatever it takes to clean him up. Everyone except Jessi, who sides with Flippy-he's named every single louse.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -滑板手相挺
programme.desc: Flippy's skating tutorials made him a star on Instaclay. Seeing his reach, Carol wants skaters to support her campaigns. But to earn their respect, she'll need to skate. With Jessi's help, Carol trains hard to master three tricks that will win the crowd-and their cause.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -中世紀的醫學
programme.desc: Falling sick in the Middle Ages is not a good idea! Dove has trouble finding a cure for Little Lewis when he falls ill. A consultation takes us on a tour of the wacky techniques and beliefs, along with typical treatments used in medieval times.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -救救南秧雞
programme.desc: When Heni's new kitten almost catches a flightless bird, Darwin and Newts decide to turn the island into a bird sanctuary.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -地層探險
programme.desc: Inspired by digging at the beach, Darwin and Newts hop on board a drilling vehicle to explore the layers of the Earth beneath their feet.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -肺臟滑行
programme.desc: Do you know how your lungs move inside your ribcage? The doctors investigate with the help of a massive water slide! And Daisy gets treated for a sore eye.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -間諜視覺
programme.desc: Eric wants to be a secret agent. He makes a periscope so he can watch the world without being seen. He discovers that the same principle is used by submarines and even by dentists.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瘋狂坑洞
programme.desc: Eric learns that most asteroids burn out before they reach our planet. But sometimes, when they're super huge, they hit Earth and make really big craters. He does an experiment to show what would happen in that situation.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...棒球棒
programme.desc: Henry meets a Baseball bat in a sports shop but Baseball Bat has never played in a championship game before.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...牧羊犬
programme.desc: Henry meets a Border Collie sheep dog and learns what a sheep dog does and why shepherds use them.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...仙人掌
programme.desc: Henry meets a Cactus in a garden centre. He becomes a Sheriff in the Wild West and Cactus becomes his deputy.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -瘋狂的催化劑
programme.desc: What is a catalyst? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of chemical engineering. Have hands-on fun by producing your own cheese, and get to know Ryong Ryoo, who discovered a rock trapping water inside it can serve as catalyst in petrochemicals.

programme.title: 南瓜報告 -雞的追逐戰
programme.desc: The Kemii finally collect a critical mass of the cloning molecule Multiplonium. But Goliath's chicken gobbles it all up, mistaking it for corn, then goes on the run and clones into 2, then 4, 8, 16 - complicating Teresa's plans to catch it.

programme.title: 動物電視台 -白尾海鵰
programme.desc: Fleabag and Plop are very impressed by the white-tailed eagle. Grey Squirrel has her suspicions about the eagle and is busy constructing a tinfoil hat. And Franky tells the cubs all about the day he met their mother.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -氣球肺
programme.desc: How do you breathe in and out? In this make we'll build a respiratory system. It sounds complicated, but it won't take lung.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -來跳舞吧
programme.desc: Gabi can't decide which animal impression to do for the annual talent show. Anabella suggests she dance like a ‘Bird of Paradise' and Gabi is intrigued. Why would a bird dance? To find out and get a video of the rarely-seen dance, the team flies to New Guinea.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -蒙蒂休假日
programme.desc: How could we have superpowers? The team flies off to Germany, to borrow some high-tech ‘super' suits. They try using a climbing suit, a jet pack and a powerlifting suit, but none is able to recover the Frisbee.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -凱文博奎斯特: 格鬥術冠軍
programme.desc: Karate champion and GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS holder Kevin Bergquist meets with Will Munford and shares the fundamentals of staying positive and focused. Kevin also teaches Will about confidence and how to use that to his advantage.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -碧安卡喬奇爾蘭: 懸浮滑板表演者
programme.desc: Young hoverboard artist Bianca Ciocirlan shares how she became the best in the world, achieving forty-five pirouettes on a hoverboard in thirty seconds. Bianca is also a professional hoverboard performer and former figure skater.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -原住民天文學
programme.desc: Native cultures have been studying the sky for centuries, yet their teachings have been mostly overlooked. Host Emily Calandrelli visits a sacred indigenous “sky party” and meets the first NASA astronaut of Native American descent.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -太空產業的未來
programme.desc: With private companies becoming involved in space exploration, the space industry is booming. Host Emily Calandrelli explores space tourism, the thriving business of satellites, and how much activity there will soon be in low-earth orbit.
