programme.title: 體操新星 -當親朋好友支持你
programme.desc: It's all changed for synchro trampoline gymnastic pair Alannah and Morgan, who have had to split as a pair because they are jumping at different heights. Morgan has been given a lovely new partner, Evie, but Alannah is still waiting for a new partner.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -消防員與仿生人
programme.desc: In this episode of Bear Grylls' Becoming Xtraordinary, Sabrina Cohen-Hatton, the most senior ranking firefighter in the UK, and Mark Ormrod, triple amputee and four-time Invictus Games gold medallist, share their incredible stories of resilience.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -折射上的反射
programme.desc: Eric does a fun experiment to show how refraction plays tricks with our eyes. He learns that when we look at objects, we see the light reflected from them. Because light doesn't travel as well through water as it does through air, things in water look different to us.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -永不放棄
programme.desc: Things aren't looking great for our Ice Stars as Kloe's lacking confidence, Josh returns home to some shattering news, and ice dancer Ella realises she'll need to work harder to keep the Adriella partnership alive.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -風箏把戲
programme.desc: Eric builds a new kite. He makes sure it is symmetrical – both sides are exactly the same – as that helps kites fly and stay balanced in the air. He learns that there are lots of different types of kites but they all need the wind to fly.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -動起來
programme.desc: The Junior Vets get sporty, helping horses at a polo match! Magda, the mare, is just back from injury – will she make it through the game? Barnaby, the rabbit, needs surgery, and a Burmese python has the sniffles. Plus, Johnny and Inel meet a naughty, food-stealing dog.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -入口
programme.desc: Alpheus Benthos announces he has found the gates to Lemuria. But soon he unleashes forces he cannot control.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -測試疼痛閾值
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand experiment with their pain tolerance. Dr. Xand shows how shoes affect how we walk. In the emergency room at the hospital, there's a suspected hand fracture and someone who caught their finger in a car door.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -生日魔術
programme.desc: In this episode we estimate someone's birth year and age by merely using a calculator. Is that really possible, and if so, how? We explain how simple arithmetic and basic algebraic conventions play an important role.

programme.title: 體操新星 -追逐夢想
programme.desc: All over England, the artistic boys are preparing for the National Championships. Ekraj has been selected for the South West team, and he has to perform at his very best to help win the team a medal.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -黛西與河馬
programme.desc: Daisy, the donkey, has a painful eye that needs sorting out. The Junior Vets give hungry hippos Ernie and Godzilla a dental check and find out if George the giraffe has any unwelcome guests.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -魔術杯
programme.desc: In this episode we teach you how to get three cups facing down in just three moves. Easy? Not at all. You start with one cup facing down and for each move you make, two of the three cups must be flipped simultaneously. Ready, set ... FLIP.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -不健康的胃口
programme.desc: A puppy with a sore paw needs help, and the Junior Vets are in at the deep end when Lacey, the horse, undergoes major surgery. Johnny and Inel meet a cat with an unhealthy appetite for human snacks.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -跳脫框架
programme.desc: In this episode Eric uses an innovative approach to get out of a sticky situation. He uses scrumptious strawberry jam on toast, lots of creative thinking and puppets to act out the problem. How can you apply Eric's techniques to your own life.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -藏寶地點X
programme.desc: When a message in a bottle washes up on shore, Darwin and Newts must use their knot knowledge to follow the trail to some pirate treasure.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -科技串連每個人
programme.desc: When rain prevents Darwin and Newts from holding a ‘show and tell' day, they use the Internet to connect with their forest whanau remotely.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -不可能的混合任務
programme.desc: Eric learns that a mixture of oil and vinegar will always end up separating because they have different densities. Shaking them will blend them again for a while. He does an experiment mixing different densities and gets some surprising results.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -彩繪白努利
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make an airbrush out of straws. Thanks to the Bernoulli principle, he uses it to create his own work of art.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -打氣機的時代
programme.desc: Eric makes a rocket from a plastic bottle and some cardboard. Then he uses an air pump to cause a transfer of energy that is strong enough to launch the rocket into the sky.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -找出犯人
programme.desc: Eric learns that everyone has their own unique fingerprint. He shows how to do a fingerprint experiment and then he uses it to find out who took a bite out of his chocolate cake.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -毫無畏懼
programme.desc: Competition season is in full swing, and Josh and Kloe are preparing for the biggest competition on the British calendar. While Josh does all he can to calm his nerves, Kloe suffers an injury during practice, and things are not looking good.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -渴求速度
programme.desc: All eyes are on speed skater Izzy who has one last chance to prove she has got what it takes to represent Team Great Britain at the Olympics. And ice dancer Ella swaps her ice skates for pedals at the velodrome.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -驚險一線間
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers take a cable car to the peak of Table Mountain National Park to discover more about the incredible plant and animal life there. Then they have the adventure of a lifetime when they go abseiling down its vertical cliffs.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -水陸交界
programme.desc: Four young adventurers head to West Coast National Park in South Africa and discover a world of seabirds and snakes. Along the way they go canoeing and snorkelling, meet wild animals and learn the value of nature parks.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -海豚
programme.desc: Today Kristina has to perform an ultrasound on Ulysses, the dolphin's, eye. But can she train Ulysses to keep her eye open long enough to perform the vital test? Meet also Garoe, a one-year-old chimp and Dali, the emperor tamarin, who has an age-old problem.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And when a normal day includes alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods, you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -厄瓜多之旅
programme.desc: Zoe's avocado tree is not in good shape, and she doesn't know how to revive it. Our friends travel to Ecuador, where they meet Idzi. He has a fabulous garden and a particular way to tend it.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅, 第一部
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo do not seem to know that there is a place on Earth where it is not at all polite to open a present in front of the person that gave it to you. Alim suggests bringing his friends to Japan, where they meet Kimiko.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -摩洛哥之旅
programme.desc: Zoe is disgusted when she sees that Alim starts eating the chocolate mousse she prepared without a spoon. Soon after, they travel to Morocco and learn more about the eating customs there.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -奈及利亞之旅
programme.desc: Alim thinks that the criteria for being beautiful are not the same from country to country. To prove that beauty standards vary across cultures, he takes his friends to Nigeria, where, as they speak, a beauty contest is taking place.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -複製
programme.desc: Robbie's wardrobe is accidentally converted into a cloning chamber, and he is quick to take advantage of having an army of himself. The new Robbies, however, have different ideas about who should be in charge.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密度強度
programme.desc: Eric uses a magic trick to show how density causes some things to float and others to sink to the bottom. He mixes different substances in an easy experiment.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -救救南秧雞
programme.desc: When Heni's new kitten almost catches a flightless bird, Darwin and Newts decide to turn the island into a bird sanctuary.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -地層探險
programme.desc: Inspired by digging at the beach, Darwin and Newts hop on board a drilling vehicle to explore the layers of the Earth beneath their feet.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -迷人的化石
programme.desc: Were all dinosaurs reptiles? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of palaeontology. Have hands-on fun by creating a dinosaur egg, and get to know Teuku Jacob, who used fossils and remains to study the origins and predecessors of present human species.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -點亮太陽系
programme.desc: What's the best way to remember the colours of the rainbow? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of light in space. Have hands-on fun by creating a kaleidoscope, and get to know Wang Zhenyi, who originated her own exact model of the solar system.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -神祕失蹤的小貓案件
programme.desc: When Mr. Tiggles goes missing, Addison must figure out if this is just a matter of a cat stuck in a tree, or a nefarious kitty kidnapping conspiracy.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -打噴嚏鼻塞之謎
programme.desc: When Mrs. Rorschach suddenly develops an allergy, every indictor points to Mr. Tiggles as the cause. Addison has to solve the mystery before Mrs. Rorschach and her kitty are forced to part ways forever.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -困在泡泡裡
programme.desc: Doki shares Oto and Anabella's bubble-gum blowing pictures online. A friend of the Worldwide Expedition Club says it reminds him of the bubbles the worms make in New Zealand. Doki is amazed – why would a worm blow bubbles? The team set off to find out.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇鬧雙胞
programme.desc: While touring Cape Canaveral, Florida, the Team meets Doki's doppelganger, an astronaut named Duncan. Doki excitedly asks - what does it take to be an astronaut? – and Duncan gives him the chance to find out.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -鉛筆
programme.desc: After scribbling away, let's explore some fun DIY ideas.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -海綿
programme.desc: Let's get creative using a sponge and see what Hepi and Briko are up to.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -奇怪的審判
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, animals are considered responsible for their actions and must answer to their crimes in a court of law! A crazy trial takes place, with Howler as the animals' attorney and Roach as the judge and persecutor.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -食物
programme.desc: Unlike life in our modern society, in the Middle Ages, people don't eat their fill every day. We follow our foodie Howler as he scavenges around for anything that takes his fancy, overstepping his mark as a mere peasant.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -領主與農民
programme.desc: Our humble peasant friend Howler can't wait for his next batch of pretzels! However, in the Middle Ages, the feudal system is ruthless, the lord always helping himself to a share of the peasant's yield. And, quite often, all that's left is a few meager crumbs.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -失蹤的長毛象
programme.desc: Ms. Bell has planned to surprise her students by hiding mammoth fossils in the school sandpit for them to dig up. But the surprise is on Ms. Bell and her students when the fossils disappear – and Addison has figure out where they went.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -可疑的圓圈之謎
programme.desc: When crop circles begin appearing in Ayrton Park, Alex suspects visitors from the fourth dimension, but Addison begins sleuthing in search of a different explanation.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -塑膠杯
programme.desc: What could we make with a paper cup? Let's find out.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -罐頭
programme.desc: Tin Tin Tin, Hepi and Briko have an unbelievable idea for these tin cans.

programme.title: 優可 -紙飛機
programme.desc: When Mai's paper airplane goes rogue, the kids go on a wild goose chase to try to get it back.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -里歐有毒
programme.desc: Leo is startled and accidentally pees on the floor in front of the Triplets. They're immediately convinced that she is poisonous. Sprinter explains that it's just pee, but as Bhilkaners can't pee, they now think they've been poisoned.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -居家改善
programme.desc: Senior asks Sprinter for help, but he's forgotten what he needs help for. Leo and Sprinter figure that he needs help hanging a picture on his wall. But when they put a nail into the wall, a crack appears.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -藍色星球
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery are at the spaceport. But while preparing to embark on an expedition into space, they fall into the ocean, which becomes the destination of their new adventures.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -珊瑚與礁石
programme.desc: A coral reef exploration goes downhill when Mr. Battery is abducted by an electric stingray.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -中國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe is writing a card to a friend but is afraid of making spelling mistakes. Is there a country in this world with no spelling rules at all? To find out, our friends travel to China, where people don't use letters but ideograms.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -墨西哥之旅
programme.desc: Alim knows a few countries where it is common to have insects as part of your menu. Our heroes are a bit taken aback. They decide to go to Taxco in Mexico, where Felipe is waiting for them to hunt some bugs! Grilled, they are a local delicacy.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -塞內加爾之旅
programme.desc: Milo doesn't know what to do with his old broken skateboard. Zoe thinks it is useless, so it just needs to be thrown away, but Alim thinks otherwise. He knows that his friend Baidi can recycle anything and everything. Off they go to Senegal to meet Baidi.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -巴布亞紐幾內亞之旅
programme.desc: Milo battles with mosquitoes using an insecticide spray but realises he can't win. Our heroes decide to pay a visit to their penfriend in Papua New Guinea and learn how to co-exist alongside mosquitoes.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -滑板大對決
programme.desc: Fico is eager to prove to his cousin Rico that he's the better skateboarder. So they all head to a skate park in Shanghai, China, to enter a big competition! But they discover that it's a team event. Is it really so important to be the best.

programme.title: 叢林樂節拍 -鶴鳥--自由自在地飛翔
programme.desc: This bird is very tired after a long flight and turns inland to rest; landing at this time of year, however, is more difficult than it seems and despite all the good attempts, the landing will not be as smooth as planned.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -元素週期表
programme.desc: How does the Periodic Table work? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of chemistry. Have hands-on fun by decoding a secret message on a blank piece of paper, and get to know Dmitri Mendeleev, a chemist and inventor – the father of the Periodic Table.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -微真菌學
programme.desc: How to make ice cream without a freezer? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of organic chemistry. Have hands-on fun by making your own ice cream, and get to know Gloria Lim, who studied fungi, their use to humans, and their role in decomposition.

programme.title: 44隻貓 -高爾夫球高手蘭爵士
programme.desc: Lampo is excluded from the golf tournament organized by Boss. So, disguised as the great golfer Sir Lamp, he challenges Boss to show him that golf is suitable for all cats, not only for snobbish and braggart ones like him.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波和小貓
programme.desc: Promised a surprise when they reach Granny's house, Ebb is sure it is doggie chocs. But it's a kitten who upsets and upstages Ebb and Bird. But the kitten is too adventurous, falls in the water and has to be rescued by Ebb. Hurrah For Ebb.

programme.title: 百變小露露 -一閃一閃亮晶晶
programme.desc: While stargazing, Luna wonders why stars twinkle. With Jupiter and Clyde, she blasts into space to uncover the true nature of stars.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -停學的緊張局勢
programme.desc: The kids are suspended and grounded again. They have only one choice for redemption - disobey their parents, break into the school at night, and discover the lab before it gets destroyed.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -大舞會
programme.desc: The first big Ball on campus means dresses, dancing, and dates. Rose attends with Hattie, the Mad Hatter's grandson, while Joy hopes to break Esquire Frog's curse with a midnight kiss. Vicky invites Candlewick from Pinocchio to turn everyone at the Ball into donkeys.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -司法與正義
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, safety's a little shaky. So is justice! It's ‘Sheriff' Howler's job to hunt down outlaws and bring them before the judge. But the methods he uses are a trifle different from what we're used to today.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -滑板大對決
programme.desc: Fico is eager to prove to his cousin Rico that he's the better skateboarder. So they all head to a skate park in Shanghai, China, to enter a big competition! But they discover that it's a team event. Is it really so important to be the best.

programme.title: 太摩和圖拉: 小小廚神 -蘑菇造型餅乾
programme.desc: Telmo and Tula use cookie dough to make various fun shapes, including mushrooms, showing kids the joy of creative baking.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -海豚
programme.desc: Today Kristina has to perform an ultrasound on Ulysses, the dolphin's, eye. But can she train Ulysses to keep her eye open long enough to perform the vital test? Meet also Garoe, a one-year-old chimp and Dali, the emperor tamarin, who has an age-old problem.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -舊金山
programme.desc: San Francisco highlights: Sailing under the Golden Gate, House of Air for slacklining and trampoline fun, Pier 39 to meet wild sea lions, and rooftop honey harvesting at Fairmont San Francisco. A week of diverse adventures with Nicole and local teens.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -科羅拉多
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain adventure: Snowboard lessons, stunt park thrills, extreme tricks at Progresh, Mega-Ramp stunts, Denver exploration, and horseback riding into the Garden of the Gods. A week of adrenaline-fueled escapades with Nicole and teens in Colorado.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -藍色星球
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery are at the spaceport. But while preparing to embark on an expedition into space, they fall into the ocean, which becomes the destination of their new adventures.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -珊瑚與礁石
programme.desc: A coral reef exploration goes downhill when Mr. Battery is abducted by an electric stingray.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -雷電交加
programme.desc: At Catatumbo Bay, a lightning storm has been raging for hundreds of years. The Nektons' investigations reveal who is responsible.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -願原力與你同在
programme.desc: Eric learns about tiny electrons and how they are connected to creating static electricity. Then he rubs his head with a balloon to create his own static electricity, and uses this to move an object without touching it.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -當我的主角吧
programme.desc: Flippy and Motor just finished their best track ever and want a video to match. Flippy dreams big-boats, mansions, even space! But Motor suggests something cheaper: animation. With help from friends, they set out to make a music video that's going to be so cool.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -神探艾伯特
programme.desc: Albert's obsessed with Sherlock Holmes and believes he shares his hero's detective skills. The others aren't so sure-except Jessi. When the class hamster vanishes from a locked cage, Albert takes the case, Jessi by his side. Robbie's the prime suspect... but is he guilty.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -童年
programme.desc: Children of noble stock receive an education in a castle environment while peasant offspring spend their youth working in the fields or at home. Daily life is busy, from a very young age. But kids never forget to have fun and goof around or playing pranks on each other.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -貝殻衫神木
programme.desc: Darwin, Newts and Heni work together to protect the big old kauri and keep it healthy.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -物體的重量
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts figure out by trial and error how to tell which can contains Heni's kitty's catfood.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -耳朵末日
programme.desc: It's poptastic! The doctors put your acoustic reflex to the test with an enormous balloon. And a serious case of snotting awaits the loser of today's Ouchology.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級形狀
programme.desc: Eric learns why the triangle is such an important shape for building. He builds a bridge made of straws that is so strong that he can balance several books on it.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -驚人的神經元
programme.desc: Eric learns that neurons are the brain's tiny building blocks. He does an experiment to show what they are and how they work. He is surprised to learn that giraffes have neurons that are five metres long.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...大象
programme.desc: Today Henry meets an old Elephant at a safari park. Elephant teaches Henry about his family tree.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...停車告示棒
programme.desc: Henry meets a Lollipop helping the crossing guards on the way to school. He becomes a crossing guard and helps all the kids across the road.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...大型電玩機
programme.desc: Henry meets an old retro arcade machine in a seaside arcade. Players are in short supply as no-one wants to play an old retro arcade game.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -探索工程
programme.desc: How do simple building elements create architecture? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of construction. Have hands-on fun by building your own tower, and get to know Fazlur Rahman Khan, who came up with the ‘tube' structure in skyscraper design.

programme.title: 南瓜報告 -照顧歌利亞
programme.desc: When Max is left alone with Goliath and their babysitter, Teresa gives him three simple rules: don't let Goliath hear organ music, smell 'chicken smoke,' or see the full moon through food, or there'll be terrible consequences.

programme.title: 動物電視台 -野兔
programme.desc: Tiny Owl is trying to explain the differences between hares and rabbits to Mommy and Daddy. Fiona Fox is engrossed in the hares on TV, and Franky has everybody in the Fox household in hysterics laughing at his terrible hare jokes.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -紙飛機起飛臺
programme.desc: Take flight with this marvellous make that is just plane fun.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -水晶洞穴
programme.desc: When Oto shares his homemade rock candy, the Team sees an odd similarity between the candy and a picture of giant crystals in Oto's rock book. It sounds crazy, but are those giant crystals candy? They set off to Chihuahua, Mexico, to find out.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -天靈靈多奇靈靈
programme.desc: When amateur magician Doki accidentally makes Gabi's worm vanish, Gabi is in a panic. How can they bring Lancelot back? To find out, Team Doki travels to a magic show in Las Vegas, Nevada to ask for help from a real magician named The Fantabulous Fenn.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -林凱毅: 解謎超級巨星
programme.desc: Lim Kai Yi is a record-breaking puzzle solver and holds the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the fastest time to solve ten Fifteen puzzles. Alan Pixsley learns the tips and tricks required to become a record-breaking solver from Lim.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -陳敬賢: 疊杯之王
programme.desc: Chan Keng Ian, a GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS holder and a speed stacking sensation, shares the mental and physical techniques required to achieve the remarkable speed and precision in the popular sport of speed stacking.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -現象級事件
programme.desc: Space tourism is becoming a common occurrence, thanks to the efforts of Blue Origin. Host Emily Calandrelli takes a look at some moments with a “big impact” in the space industry today.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -最愛片段特輯
programme.desc: Xploration Outer Space has over 75 episodes, and host Emily Calandrelli has been there every step of way. In this special episode, Emily recalls some of her favorite moments, ranging from cutting edge science to adventures with our #StudentAstronaut contest winners.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -耳朵末日
programme.desc: It's poptastic! The doctors put your acoustic reflex to the test with an enormous balloon. And a serious case of snotting awaits the loser of today's Ouchology.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級形狀
programme.desc: Eric learns why the triangle is such an important shape for building. He builds a bridge made of straws that is so strong that he can balance several books on it.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -驚人的神經元
programme.desc: Eric learns that neurons are the brain's tiny building blocks. He does an experiment to show what they are and how they work. He is surprised to learn that giraffes have neurons that are five metres long.

programme.title: 體操新星 -永遠相信自己
programme.desc: Finally, it's competition time for the Acro gymnasts as they head off to Liverpool for the British Championships. Harry and George hope to make a great impression, and superstar choreographer Andrew has been called in to fine-tune the boys' performance.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -GOAT與賽車手
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, tennis legend, French Open, and Grand Slam winner, Roger Federer, and the world's most successful woman in Indy car racing, Danica Patrick, share their stories on becoming the best in the world.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -秘密訊息
programme.desc: Eric learns that, with a little science, you can bring out all the colours that make up the black ink in felt tip markers. He separates the colours using chromatography. This gives him a way to write secret messages.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -孤注一擲
programme.desc: It's a busy week for our Ice Stars. Charlie and Freddie have tryouts for a different sort of ice sport. Meanwhile, the Icicles are taking a break from their busy schedule and having some fun off the ice. And Asiyah is waiting for an important call.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -壯觀的病菌
programme.desc: Eric discovers that washing your hands can prevent the spread of bacteria. He does an experiment to show how easy it is to spread these tiny germs from person to person.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -新名字
programme.desc: Can the Junior Vets determine the sex of a very special penguin? Six cute kittens need checkups and new names - meet X-ray, Smudge, and, of course, baby Johnny! And Paul, the rat, has trouble breathing.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -這裡有龍
programme.desc: A dragon-hunting expedition leads Ant to find an ancient scroll that holds clues to an amazing mystery.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -從嘴到胃
programme.desc: The doctors demonstrate how the mouth, nose and stomach are all connected. Dr. Xand visits a freezing room and Dr. Chris meets a robot surgeon. In the emergency room at the hospital, one patient has a stone in his ear and another has a broken elbow.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -自畫像
programme.desc: This episode shows how an artist can determine the accurate placement of eyes, ears, nose, chin, and lips on portraits by using proportions. We show you how you can do the same by just using a string and applying some rules about the human body.

programme.title: 體操新星 -真摯友誼
programme.desc: Best friends Talia and Theo are getting prepared for the British Trampoline Championships. Talia takes Theo to the funfair to help take his mind off his worries before the big event.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -露比的臭腳
programme.desc: The Junior Vets are on the farm, hoping to discover some pregnant cows. Poor Fern, the lurcher, has been abandoned and needs a new home. Ruby, the lamb, has a smelly infected foot, and Johnny and Inel meet a dog who likes to join the family for dinner.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -解題關鍵
programme.desc: Say what?! This episode focuses on the importance of reading math problems very carefully in order to fully understand the problem at hand. Because if you don't answer the right question, how can the solution ever be right.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -來抓我
programme.desc: Today, the Junior Vets meet some feisty meerkats who need their claws trimmed, but first, they've got to catch them. Ashanti, the elephant, gets his feet and tail cleaned. Johnny and Inel discover what you get when you cross a lion and a tiger.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -配對襪子
programme.desc: In this episode we explain the concept of 'probability'. How can we weigh all our possibilities to eventually pick the most likely outcome? In order to illustrate our options, Eric rearranges his messy sock drawer – blindfolded.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -奇異果山谷救援小隊
programme.desc: When one of their friends gets hurt, Darwin and Newts form the Kiwifruit Valley Rescue Team to help in an emergency.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -黑妮的雞舍
programme.desc: When Heni's new chickens take over her garden, Darwin and Newts come up with a plan to keep everyone happy.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密度強度
programme.desc: Eric uses a magic trick to show how density causes some things to float and others to sink to the bottom. He mixes different substances in an easy experiment.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -貓熊與金剛鸚鵡
programme.desc: Posse, the red panda, and Santiago, the saki, have been having issues with their teeth and the dentist brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue-throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -視線錯覺, 我的眼睛
programme.desc: Eric is fooled by an optical illusion with three lines. Then he draws a goldfish and a bowl and sticks them to a pencil to create his own optical illusion.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -虎鯨寶寶
programme.desc: Morgan, the deaf orca, is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff at Loro Parque are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瓶中龍捲風
programme.desc: Eric pretends to be a tornado. He finds out they happen when the wind starts rotating really fast in a vortex – a whirlpool shape. Then he learns how to make a tornado using recycled plastic bottles.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克製造風
programme.desc: Eric learns that an anemometer – an instrument to measure wind speed – is important for sailors and for pilots. Then he learns how to make one himself.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -希望與夢想
programme.desc: The Icicles have made it to the World Synchro Championships and are heading to Canada. After a season of flawless performances, can the girls pull off their Bollywood routine? The end of season Gala is near, but preparations aren't running as smoothly as everyone hoped.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -宴會時間
programme.desc: As the ice skating season draws to a close, there is the annual event in the calendar that everyone is talking about. All the Ice Stars gather together for some sensational Hollywood-themed performances. For the Icicles, it's the last time they'll skate together.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -沿岸沙漠
programme.desc: Four young adventurers explore Namaqua National Park in South Africa, a desert region with the largest concentration of succulent plants in the world. They learn how to survive in its harsh environment by learning ancient traditions.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -沙漠花開
programme.desc: Four young adventurers discover how plants, animals and people survive in the harsh desert environment of Namaqua National Park in South Africa. The short rainy season has started and the desert is in full bloom.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -中國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe is writing a card to a friend but is afraid of making spelling mistakes. Is there a country in this world with no spelling rules at all? To find out, our friends travel to China, where people don't use letters but ideograms.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -墨西哥之旅
programme.desc: Alim knows a few countries where it is common to have insects as part of your menu. Our heroes are a bit taken aback. They decide to go to Taxco in Mexico, where Felipe is waiting for them to hunt some bugs! Grilled, they are a local delicacy.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -塞內加爾之旅
programme.desc: Milo doesn't know what to do with his old broken skateboard. Zoe thinks it is useless, so it just needs to be thrown away, but Alim thinks otherwise. He knows that his friend Baidi can recycle anything and everything. Off they go to Senegal to meet Baidi.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -巴布亞紐幾內亞之旅
programme.desc: Milo battles with mosquitoes using an insecticide spray but realises he can't win. Our heroes decide to pay a visit to their penfriend in Papua New Guinea and learn how to co-exist alongside mosquitoes.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -殭屍化
programme.desc: Motor creates a new computer game whose addictiveness threatens the productivity of the entire world.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -生生不息
programme.desc: Eric uses a hula hoop to explore nature and create a special research area teeming with life. Using the hoop helps him identify, count and keep track of the tiny creatures and plants he finds.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -貝殻衫神木
programme.desc: Darwin, Newts and Heni work together to protect the big old kauri and keep it healthy.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -物體的重量
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts figure out by trial and error how to tell which can contains Heni's kitty's catfood.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -元素週期表
programme.desc: How does the Periodic Table work? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of chemistry. Have hands-on fun by decoding a secret message on a blank piece of paper, and get to know Dmitri Mendeleev, a chemist and inventor – the father of the Periodic Table.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -微真菌學
programme.desc: How to make ice cream without a freezer? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of organic chemistry. Have hands-on fun by making your own ice cream, and get to know Gloria Lim, who studied fungi, their use to humans, and their role in decomposition.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -失蹤的長毛象
programme.desc: Ms. Bell has planned to surprise her students by hiding mammoth fossils in the school sandpit for them to dig up. But the surprise is on Ms. Bell and her students when the fossils disappear – and Addison has figure out where they went.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -可疑的圓圈之謎
programme.desc: When crop circles begin appearing in Ayrton Park, Alex suspects visitors from the fourth dimension, but Addison begins sleuthing in search of a different explanation.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -來跳舞吧
programme.desc: Gabi can't decide which animal impression to do for the annual talent show. Anabella suggests she dance like a ‘Bird of Paradise' and Gabi is intrigued. Why would a bird dance? To find out and get a video of the rarely-seen dance, the team flies to New Guinea.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -蒙蒂休假日
programme.desc: How could we have superpowers? The team flies off to Germany, to borrow some high-tech ‘super' suits. They try using a climbing suit, a jet pack and a powerlifting suit, but none is able to recover the Frisbee.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -塑膠杯
programme.desc: What could we make with a paper cup? Let's find out.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -罐頭
programme.desc: Tin Tin Tin, Hepi and Briko have an unbelievable idea for these tin cans.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -煉金術
programme.desc: Welcome to the world of medieval alchemy, introduced by our mad scientist friend, Howler! He's looking for a way to transmute lead into gold: it's the only way to escape insatiable Lord Roach's fort as the greedy noble seeks to increase his fortune.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宮廷愛情
programme.desc: Dove is going through a rocky time with her horrible husband, Lord Roach. She consequently falls for Sir Howler. Despite being humble and loyal, Howler isn't always a paragon of finesse when it comes to winning the lady's heart or dealing with the jealous spouse.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -騎士們
programme.desc: Little Lewis follows every step in order to achieve his dream. After completing a plethora of thankless tasks at a young age, he moves on to the rank of ‘squire.' A chance to demonstrate his bravery on the battlefield, in order to be knighted, at last.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -隱藏寶石之謎
programme.desc: When Addison and Tess find a note in a funny old pair of rummage sale pants, they think they may have found a clue to lead them to a stash of priceless hidden diamonds.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -壞女孩一號偵探社之謎
programme.desc: When the school mean girls, Katie and Dinara, start their own detective agency and solve a rash of neighbourhood mysteries before Addison can, she wonders if she's lost her touch...or if there is something else more nefarious going on.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -松果
programme.desc: Creativity has no limits! Watch Hepi and Briko transform these cones into something lovely.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -塑膠湯匙
programme.desc: Hepi and Briko reuse spoons to make some cute DIY's.

programme.title: 優可 -顏色
programme.desc: The kids have to learn about compromise when they try to decide what colour to paint a birdhouse: yellow, red, or blue.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -釣魚之旅
programme.desc: Senior comes to Sprinter's house to invite him on a fishing trip. Sprinter wants to catch some flying fish, but Senior is hunting for the mythical cloud whale, which is said to be impossible to catch.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -里歐堅硬的外表
programme.desc: Leo feels sad because she's smaller than everyone else. Sprinter builds her a robot making her as tall as him. But is everything going to be easier when you're as tall as everyone else, or is it better to be the size that you're.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -風暴與海浪
programme.desc: Surfing the waves leads Kit and Mr. Battery into a dangerous storm.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -最大的動物
programme.desc: Mr. Battery collects photos of the largest animals, but he's still missing a photo of the mysterious giant squid.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -荷蘭之旅
programme.desc: On which day in December should people receive their presents? Zoe and Milo are sure that it should be on Christmas, but Alim explains that in some countries, this happens on December 6th. They travel to the Netherlands and learn the story of St. Nicholas.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -西藏之旅
programme.desc: Zoe has started to make a mandala and she needs Milo's beautiful colouring pencils to finish it. That is not a problem for Milo, except that his pencil box is empty! How can Zoe finish her mandala without colouring pencils? A trip to Tibet soon appears to be necessary.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -布吉納法索之旅
programme.desc: In Burkina Faso, our heroes' penfriend Jamal can't wait to introduce Zoe and Milo to his parents, and like Alim, he appears to have several mums and dads. What a mystery.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -沙烏地阿拉伯之旅
programme.desc: Our heroes travel to Saudi Arabia and meet up with Ahed. He knows different ways to move in the desert by day and night, but what he does not know is where his goats have gone. He is going to need some help from his friends.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇探險隊的大冒險
programme.desc: While practicing some circus-style tricks, team Doki gets an idea to put on a real circus show for all their friends of the Worldwide Expedition Club. Doki wants it to be amazing, so they set off to a real circus to find out how to put on the Greatest Show on Earth.

programme.title: 叢林樂節拍 -刺蝟--地底深處
programme.desc: The hedgehog has dug a beautiful hole. Lovely, except that he made it so deep that he can not climb out. He creates an escape tunnel, but it only takes him further and further away. Welcome to the jungle where funny animals live and play.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -電流力學
programme.desc: How do batteries work? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of electricity. Have hands-on fun by making a battery using lemons, and get to know Nikola Tesla, physicist, engineer and inventor, who conceived the modern alternating current supply system.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環保科學和回收
programme.desc: What's the difference between science and green science? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of renewable energy. Have hands-on fun by making your lettuce sustainable, and get to know Ryoji Noyori, a chemist and great advocate of green chemistry.

programme.title: 44隻貓 -皮露鬆動的牙齒
programme.desc: Pilou notices she has a loose tooth and she's a bit scared: she doesn't want to touch it because she's afraid it could be painful! Isotta calms her down and suggests her to visit her kitten Mimi, the pediatrician cat.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波的冬日大衣
programme.desc: Granny has knitted an orange and purple striped coat for Ebb. Flo takes Ebb for a beach walk in the new coat. But it's too hot. Ebb takes a dip. Ebb's coat stretches and stretches. Ebb and Bird find they have a new orange and purple winter blanket.

programme.title: 百變小露露 -美麗的土星環
programme.desc: Looking through the telescope, Jupiter spots Saturn and its rings. Can you walk on them? Luna, Jupiter, and Clyde turn into planets to find out.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -未來只是徒勞
programme.desc: The four friends reach a dead end and, even worse, are caught by the lurking Bruno Black. Bruno gives our heroes a sobering reality check, but Hulk refuses to give up, even when all hope is lost.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -傳說級的鐵扇
programme.desc: Regal Academy faces Shan Academy in a track-and-field competition. Hawk, Travis, and Astoria are beaten by LingLing, Princess IronFan's granddaughter. Rose must find LingLing's weakness: a love of frilly dresses, to save the day.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -黑死病
programme.desc: The Black Plague is running rampant through Europe, leaving death and destruction in its wake! This episode provides a catalog of the effects the plague has on the human body and the various weird and wonderful cures dreamed up by the contemporary medics.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇探險隊的大冒險
programme.desc: While practicing some circus-style tricks, team Doki gets an idea to put on a real circus show for all their friends of the Worldwide Expedition Club. Doki wants it to be amazing, so they set off to a real circus to find out how to put on the Greatest Show on Earth.

programme.title: 太摩和圖拉: 小小廚神 -熱帶風味三明治
programme.desc: Telmo and Tula have fun cooking a simple recipe that everybody will be able to follow: a tropical sandwich.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And when a normal day includes alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods, you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -費城
programme.desc: Philly love: Rowing at Boathouse Row, history walk at Independence Hall, mural art with the Mural Arts Program, and pretzel twisting at Philadelphia Pretzel Factory. A week of cultural immersion with Nicole and local teens.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -猶他
programme.desc: Utah adventure: White water rafting near Salt Lake City, bobsled racing at Utah Olympic Park, fearless rappelling in Moab, and off-the-grid dinosaur excavation. A week of thrilling escapades with Nicole and local teens in the great state of Utah.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -風暴與海浪
programme.desc: Surfing the waves leads Kit and Mr. Battery into a dangerous storm.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -最大的動物
programme.desc: Mr. Battery collects photos of the largest animals, but he's still missing a photo of the mysterious giant squid.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -入口
programme.desc: Alpheus Benthos announces he has found the gates to Lemuria. But soon he unleashes forces he cannot control.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -絕妙的五感體驗
programme.desc: Eric is blindfolded and has to figure out what a mystery object is using his other four senses – hearing, taste, touch and smell. He learns that although most animals have the same senses people do, they use them differently.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -無人機
programme.desc: It's Carol's birthday and her famous cake is a hit-except Motor's not there. He's sent a drone instead. Just a phase, says Albert. But when Naomi, Flippy, and Robbie show up as drones too, things spiral fast. The world's going drone, and Carol wants to hide from it all.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -時間靜止
programme.desc: Something's up! Every time Robbie pulls a prank, it gets undone. He soon notices Motor is always nearby-wearing strange bracelets. Curious, Robbie steals them and discovers Motor's secret: he's been stopping time to fix things. Now it's Robbie's turn... for fun.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宴會
programme.desc: Howler and Dove are invited to Lord Roach's banquet. But banquets come with all kinds of rules and regulations, exposing the greedier guests in the room! Hardened foodies, they indulge in all kinds of scheming.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -企鵝救援行動
programme.desc: When an iceberg brings an emperor penguin and his egg into the Bay, Darwin and Newts help him get home.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -3、2、1發射火箭
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts build a three-stage rocket to send a camera high above the clouds to photograph Matariki.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -英雄海馬迴
programme.desc: It's amazing! There's a furry friend in the lab as the doctors reveal how your brain's hippocampus works to create maps so you don't get lost.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級降落傘
programme.desc: Eric makes a parachute that will slow down a falling egg just enough so it doesn't get smashed when it hits the ground. But first he experiments to figure out the best parachute size. He discovers that NASA also use parachutes to drop robotic probes on to the moon.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克造紙
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make a beautiful sheet of recycled paper. He finds out what people used to write on before paper was invented.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...芭蕾舞鞋
programme.desc: Henry meets a pair of ballet shoes at a dance rehearsal class, and becomes a ballet dancer.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...洗手台
programme.desc: Henry goes into the bathroom to wash his hands and meets a Sink. Tap offers to wash Henry's hands but no water comes out of his spout.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...獎盃
programme.desc: Henry meets a trophy in the trophy shop, and helps Trophy to find the cabinet with all his friends.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -天啊!天文學
programme.desc: How do rockets manage to defy gravity? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of astronomy. Have hands-on fun by launching your own rocket, and get to know Edwin Hubble, an astronomer, who proved the universe consists of entire galaxies and is expanding.

programme.title: 南瓜報告 -馬爾他之雞
programme.desc: When the school mascot, a golden chicken statue, goes missing, with Max as the only suspect, Police Officer Dorcas becomes a Sam-Spade-like sleuth, chasing down confusing clues as Max fights to clear his name.

programme.title: 動物電視台 -獾
programme.desc: Grandad thinks that the badger on TV is a distant cousin of his. Grey's noisy popcorn eating makes it impossible for Red to watch the show. And despite Tiny Owl's protests, Mommy and Daddy are convinced that the animal they're watching on TV is a panda.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -卡祖笛
programme.desc: Play your funky music and feel the sound waves with this scientific instrument.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -難忘的騎士
programme.desc: Doki figures that to be a knight, all you had to do was joust. Gabi thinks there was more to it than that – but what did you have to do to become a knight? To find out, they head to a medieval festival in England and discover the true meaning of ‘chivalry'.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -巨大錢幣
programme.desc: Why do some coins have holes in them? The team flies to Yap, Micronesia, where coins have holes. But to get one of the valuable ‘rai', they have to make and trade a handmade canoe! After the exchange, the Team learns there's been a big misunderstanding.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -弗洛里安科勒: 非凡特技撞球員
programme.desc: GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS holder Florian Kohler, also known as 'Venom', demonstrates his precise pool trick-shot skills, sharing the key to his success and what it takes to be a renowned trick-shot performer.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -凱登蓋拉提亞克: 冰上曲棍球奇才
programme.desc: Hockey prodigy Kaden Galatiuk meets Alan Pixsley and shares how he used his razor-sharp precision to achieve the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the most hockey pucks hit into a target on inline skates in one minute.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -踏進外太空
programme.desc: Space exploration helps extend the reach of the human race to beyond our planet. But is everyone welcome on that journey? Host Emily Calandrelli explores the ways different people, companies and organizations are helping make spaceflight more accessible.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -太空中的生命
programme.desc: The search for life in the universe remains one of the most ambitious quests of humankind. Host Emily Calandrelli explores the possibility that life exists in our own celestial backyard.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -英雄海馬迴
programme.desc: It's amazing! There's a furry friend in the lab as the doctors reveal how your brain's hippocampus works to create maps so you don't get lost.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級降落傘
programme.desc: Eric makes a parachute that will slow down a falling egg just enough so it doesn't get smashed when it hits the ground. But first he experiments to figure out the best parachute size. He discovers that NASA also use parachutes to drop robotic probes on to the moon.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克造紙
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make a beautiful sheet of recycled paper. He finds out what people used to write on before paper was invented.

programme.title: 體操新星 -出人意料
programme.desc: Acrobatic pair Finn and Kirsten are used to winning medals - they even took home the bronze for Great Britain at the World Acrobatic Championships. But now they will compete as seniors for the first time at the British Championships in Liverpool.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -明星與戰士
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, Julia Roberts relives her journey to becoming an Oscar winning actress and Wladimir Klitschko shares how he became an Olympic gold medallist and record breaking world heavyweight boxing champion.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -熱的顏色
programme.desc: Eric learns that wearing light colours in the sun keeps you cooler than dark colours. He does an ice cube experiment to how lighter colours reflect light and heat, just like a mirror.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -主場與客場
programme.desc: Ice hockey brothers Rais and Aren are off to Canada for the trip of a lifetime, as Aren has a tournament and is hoping to make his family proud. And Ella and Asiyah are showing us just what determined young skaters they are.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -肥皂帆船
programme.desc: Eric makes a model boat using soap as fuel. The boat moves because the soap breaks the surface tension of the water, causing the water molecules to repel each other and push each other backwards into the boat.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -健身日
programme.desc: Today at the pet gym Cassie, the lazy Labrador, goes swimming, and will Fudge, the fat cat, ever get up? Down in the wild woods, the Junior Vets meet even bigger cats – the Eurasian lynx, Europe's third-largest predator.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -黑虎鯨
programme.desc: The Dark Orca pirates attack! They believe the Nektons have a rare treasure aboard their submarine.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -從暈車到一夜好眠
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand explain what happens when you feel travel sick and investigate the importance of sleep. In the emergency room, there are tummy troubles and an injured hand.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -不可能的折紙任務
programme.desc: Why can a regular sheet of paper not be folded more than six times? Mathemagician Eric learns that by folding a sheet of paper in half, over and over again, the thickness of the paper doesn't just double: it increases exponentially.

programme.title: 體操新星 -上場時刻
programme.desc: Corey won the title of British Champion for his age group last year, but he has moved up and is now the youngest in his category. Finn and Kirsten have been invited to showcase their talents to some younger gymnasts and hand out medals at the annual awards ceremony.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -獸醫值班中
programme.desc: The Junior Vets check out some lovely lemurs, get up close with Fluffy, the python, and meet a vulture called Derek! Plus, some cute little piglets need help, and Johnny and Inel meet a singing dog.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -正四面體的樹
programme.desc: In this episode Eric tries to solve an age-old mystery: How should four trees be placed if the distances between them need to be the same? To find an answer, Eric uses three-dimensional objects called ‘tetrahedrons'.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -潑辣的獾
programme.desc: Today Matilda, the horse, has surgery, and a cute but feisty badger needs help after being hit by a car. The Junior Vets release Timbuktu, the hedgehog, back into the wild, and Johnny and Inel find out how fish sleep and meet a dog with a passion for pop music.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -神奇的9
programme.desc: In this episode, mathemagician Eric reveals a cool math trick that illustrates the special properties of the number 9. Follow a given sequence ... multiply by three, add three, multiply by three, and then add two digits. What just happened?! It's not magic ... it's math.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -老人家的智慧
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts meet Pupu Rangi's grandma, Kuia Gooey, and discover there's so much that our grandparents can teach us.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -鯨喜時刻
programme.desc: Darwin, Newts and Heni look after and re-float a whale that has become stranded in the bay.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -生生不息
programme.desc: Eric uses a hula hoop to explore nature and create a special research area teeming with life. Using the hoop helps him identify, count and keep track of the tiny creatures and plants he finds.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -佐治的一天
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, is hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -蟲蟲來襲
programme.desc: Eric learns that insects have a head, thorax, abdomen, antennae, and six legs. He is surprised to find out that spiders are not insects – they are arachnids.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -小丑魚與白虎
programme.desc: We follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more clownfish to come. In the meantime, Lin Mao, the white tiger, has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -旋轉的種子
programme.desc: Eric learns that plants have different ways to make their seeds fly as far away as possible. He makes his own version of the maple seed, which looks like a little paper helicopter.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密碼
programme.desc: Eric learns that computer coding means writing programmes that tell robots and computers how to do certain jobs. Just as we use language to communicate with other people, there are lots of different programming or 'coding' languages to talk to computers.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -鎮上的新男孩
programme.desc: The ice-dancing girls are desperate for boy partners, and new boy Adriano is moving from Italy to Nottingham to find himself a dance partner. Nine-year-old Charlie lives and breathes ice hockey, but has he got what it takes to impress the coach.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -重大的決定
programme.desc: Ice dancer Adriano has finally chosen his new dance partner, so it's time to tell Chloe and Ella who he's picked. And speed skater Maddie loves going fast, but a mysterious illness has affected her training. She has a new plan which she hopes will help her recover.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -神的領地
programme.desc: Four young adventurers travel to Tshavhadzimu in Mapungubwe National Park. They search for a cave with rock art, run into a herd of elephants and almost step on a dangerous snake.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -泉湧之山
programme.desc: Four young adventurers travel to Marakele National Park in South Africa. They spot baby impalas and a pride of lions, and almost walk into a herd of White Rhino. While travelling on foot they come across a battle between Matabele ants and termites.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -荷蘭之旅
programme.desc: On which day in December should people receive their presents? Zoe and Milo are sure that it should be on Christmas, but Alim explains that in some countries, this happens on December 6th. They travel to the Netherlands and learn the story of St. Nicholas.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -西藏之旅
programme.desc: Zoe has started to make a mandala and she needs Milo's beautiful colouring pencils to finish it. That is not a problem for Milo, except that his pencil box is empty! How can Zoe finish her mandala without colouring pencils? A trip to Tibet soon appears to be necessary.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -布吉納法索之旅
programme.desc: In Burkina Faso, our heroes' penfriend Jamal can't wait to introduce Zoe and Milo to his parents, and like Alim, he appears to have several mums and dads. What a mystery.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -沙烏地阿拉伯之旅
programme.desc: Our heroes travel to Saudi Arabia and meet up with Ahed. He knows different ways to move in the desert by day and night, but what he does not know is where his goats have gone. He is going to need some help from his friends.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -生病
programme.desc: Robbie pretends to be ill to avoid an exam, and starts to enjoy the sympathy that everybody shows him despite Flippy's pleas that he stops faking.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -摩擦力和現實
programme.desc: Eric learns about friction by rolling a ball over different surfaces and rubbing his hands together to warm them up. He discovers there is no friction in space.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -企鵝救援行動
programme.desc: When an iceberg brings an emperor penguin and his egg into the Bay, Darwin and Newts help him get home.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -3、2、1發射火箭
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts build a three-stage rocket to send a camera high above the clouds to photograph Matariki.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -電流力學

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -隱藏寶石之謎
programme.desc: When Addison and Tess find a note in a funny old pair of rummage sale pants, they think they may have found a clue to lead them to a stash of priceless hidden diamonds.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -壞女孩一號偵探社之謎

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -松果

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -塑膠湯匙
programme.desc: Hepi and Briko reuse spoons to make some cute DIY's.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -貓熊與金剛鸚鵡

programme.desc: Addison and her classmates are tasked with playing a piece of music written by a local billionaire, who has promised to donate funding to the school's music program – but only if Addison can solve a musical puzzle and correctly fill in the blanks in the sheet music.

programme.desc: Addison's and Tess's fairy garden school project attracts a mysterious glowing frog, and while Alex thinks it's radioactive and Tess believes it's a magical fairy frog, Addison is determined to find the real answer to this amphibious mystery.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -A4紙張

programme.desc: Socks are not just to keep your feet warm! Hepi and Briko have some interesting sock-themed ideas.

programme.title: 優可 -優可五百賽車
programme.desc: When a competitive race gets out of control, the kids have to choose between winning at any cost or helping their friends.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -會長大的鞋子

programme.title: 打造貓樂園 -貓迷宮

programme.title: 深海大探險 -來自星星

programme.title: 深海大探險 -波羅的海的異象
programme.desc: Ant finds a mysterious box. But a swarm of rabidly voracious “things” emerge, chasing him.

programme.desc: Meet a peasant family in their daily lives, back in the Middle Ages. Dove and Howler are very busy parents! Besides educating their little urchin kids, welcoming a new baby, dealing with daily home life, life for these peasant parents is eventful to say the least.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -神探艾伯特
programme.desc: Albert's obsessed with Sherlock Holmes and believes he shares his hero's detective skills. The others aren't so sure-except Jessi. When the class hamster vanishes from a locked cage, Albert takes the case, Jessi by his side. Robbie's the prime suspect... but is he guilty.

programme.title: 優可 -雪球

programme.title: 優可 -完美的野餐
programme.desc: When the kids can't agree on a perfect picnic location, they learn that compromise is important so everyone can have fun.

programme.desc: On a walk to the shops, the Grimwade family encounters a lot of traffic. Daddy thinks it's not a good idea to go out today. But everyone else wants to go to the park. Let's go green and solve the problem of pollution.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -一座橋
programme.desc: Help Pooch get over the gap by building a nice strong bridge! We're here to support you.

programme.desc: When the kids discover that Yoko is the cause of an awful smell, they have to convince him to take his very first bath.

programme.desc: You'll lava this one. We'll show you how to use a bottle and oil in this make that bubbles and boils.

programme.desc: Zoe and Milo have formed a band. They want Alim to be part of it, but the hamster insists on using empty cans as drums. For Zoe and Milo, that is not a proper instrument. Alim knows it's possible to play music with all sorts of things. It's time for a trip to Louisiana.

programme.title: 小小致富夢想家 -呱呱鞋
programme.desc: When Shirley finds success with a simple invention, the gang decides to create a useless product that'll sell in huge numbers. Max worries that Noodles is jumping ship to work for Shirley.

programme.desc: Our two rising stars from Birmingham - Seb and Shakiem - are preparing and mastering new skills for the Tumbling British Championships. Meanwhile, Finn and Kirsten are busy training for the Acrobatic British Championships.

programme.desc: The Junior Vets are facing tough challenges and unusual tasks. From swimming with critically endangered sharks to performing tricky surgery on a dog's knee, the kids are trying to prove they've got what it takes to care for unwell animals.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -馬賽克大混亂
programme.desc: Doki accidentally breaks Anabella's vintage tea tray and she's mad. Doki wants to make it up to her, but how can he fix her broken tea tray? The team heads to Istanbul, Turkey, where a ‘puzzle solving pro' is putting together fragments of an ancient ruin.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -蘿拉畢昂多: 花式足球冠軍
programme.desc: Laura Biondo holds many GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS titles, including the one for most football control tricks in one minute. Laura is a renowned football freestyler and is currently the first and only Latin American to win a football freestyle world championship.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -切布卡與奇儂索 : 知名花式足球員
programme.desc: Chinonso Eche and his coach, Chukwuebuka Ezugha, are both football freestylers who hold many GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS titles. They meet Alan Pixsley and teach him the basics of football freestyle.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -地球以外的生命
programme.desc: An investigative team tackles one of the biggest questions of our time: Are we alone? Meanwhile, Emily travels to the SETI institute to meet with leading scientists Jill Tarter and Seth Shostak to learn how we are searching for intelligent life in our universe.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -小行星
programme.desc: Emily is joined by experts who are learning everything they can about asteroids and their potential impact on earth. From the dinosaur killer to the Chelyabinsk meteor of 2013 - we learn about the destructive power of asteroids.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -來聊聊癌症
programme.desc: The doctors talk about cancer, explaining what it is, why people get it, how it can be treated, and how to help someone going through it.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -不可能的混合任務
programme.desc: Eric learns that a mixture of oil and vinegar will always end up separating because they have different densities. Shaking them will blend them again for a while. He does an experiment mixing different densities and gets some surprising results.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密度強度
programme.desc: Eric uses a magic trick to show how density causes some things to float and others to sink to the bottom. He mixes different substances in an easy experiment.

programme.title: 體操新星 -離開舒適圈
programme.desc: The artistic seniors are back from the World Championships and have qualified for the next Olympic Games, so it's time for the coaches to start thinking about who will make up the Olympic team. Amelie and Phoebe have been invited to an elite training camp in Liverpool.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -發明家與叛逆者
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, inventor and most cited engineer in history Robert Langer and recipient of the Nobel Prize for chemistry, Frances Arnold, reflect on their award-winning careers in science.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瓶中的星星
programme.desc: Eric learns constellations are groups of stars and that they often have shapes that look like animals, objects, or even people. He makes a lantern that can project the constellation Ursa Major, also known as the Great Bear because it looks like a big bear in the sky.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -戰場
programme.desc: The Icicles are in Austria for the Synchro World Championships. They have to pull out a show-stopping performance to beat their rivals. Josh and Kloe get into the spirit of Christmas, and disaster strikes for Charlie in his speed skating debut.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -生生不息
programme.desc: Eric uses a hula hoop to explore nature and create a special research area teeming with life. Using the hoop helps him identify, count and keep track of the tiny creatures and plants he finds.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -親身的獸醫體驗
programme.desc: Sam is due to operate on Stella, the dog after she got injured in a car crash. But is he ready to take part in urgent surgery? Plus, the Junior Vets join the emergency response team at the races and help heal hurt hooves down on the Vet School farm.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -惡魔海之謎
programme.desc: Are aliens stealing things from a Japanese island and dragging them underwater? The Nektons investigate and find something dangerous.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -捐血救人一命
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand do an experiment to show how eating different types of food affected their poo. Dr. Xand donates blood and finds out how it is processed. There are patients with a cut hand and a cut eyebrow in the emergency room.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -破解密碼
programme.desc: By shifting the alphabet or replacing one letter for another further down the sequence, a coded message can be deciphered. In this episode, Eric uses the trick to crack an ancient box used by Roman Emperor Julius Caesar. Can you do the same.

programme.title: 體操新星 -挫敗
programme.desc: It's not good news for Chase, who heads to the hospital after suffering an injury at the gym and has a nervous wait to find out how long he'll be out of action. And Acro duo Dylan and Lola join the Acro squad for their first big international competition in Portugal.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -克服恐懼
programme.desc: Sam and Morgan operate on Gandalf the falcon's lumpy foot. And the Junior Vets are about to find out what real vet work is all about. But will Saira overcome her fear of big dogs to help stray hound Jessie, who needs life-changing surgery.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -神祕的腫塊
programme.desc: The Junior Vets are trying to get to the bottom of Benji the dog's painful pee problem. And Gary, the axolotl, arrives at Vet School with a mysterious lump. Can the Junior Vets work out what's wrong.

programme.desc: 魚常侍派白望入去殺李善德，趕巧被鄭平安撞見了，為了讓李善德帶着袖兒有時間逃離，鄭平安攔下了白望人，卻倒在了血泊中。鄭平安奄奄一息，說自幼膽小，今日能為保護家人勇敢一回。桂花樹宛若盛放，李善德和袖兒究竟能躲過了這一劫嗎.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 縱貫南北的千里長河，書寫人水共生的中國方案，向北方輸送源源不絕的清泉，背後是百萬「守水人」的誓言；當西溪濕地重現珍稀飛鳥，桃花水母成為水質「晴雨表」，這些工作使我們深切了解，清水源流是文明延續的生命基因.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 在創意驅動的市場裡，知識產權是品牌成長背後的重要後盾。香港有一個本地曲奇品牌，由用心的創作者以品質與誠意打動顧客，逐步建立屬於自己的口碑。. 今集將帶大家了解，品牌如何運用商標保障自身形象，守護品牌價值，在激烈競爭中脫穎而出，并且透過持續創新，讓一塊曲奇成為能被記住的故事，延伸出更大的品牌力量.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：濾鏡手鐲再次升級
programme.desc: 方謹在蘇橙橙等人的鼓勵下，終於自信地在發佈會上介紹了自己的專利。發佈會結束後，唐奇遇見由蘇橙橙變身的方謹，兩人一起看着彩虹，她的一番談話，引得唐奇動情告白，假方謹落荒而逃。此時，濾鏡再次升級完成，蘇橙橙一覺醒來發現自己變身成林媛畫出來的男人全勝唐.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 細味風情
programme.desc: 巴巴多斯、聖文森特格林納丁斯都是較少人認識的加勒比島嶼，位於南美次大陸附近。它們被稱為「風向群島」，如同頸鏈上的珍珠。當地的原居民是美洲印第安人的後裔，後來，部分與歐洲人及非洲奴隸血統混合。如今，當地人已經掌握悠閒的生活方式.

政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
香港故事：邊境人家
programme.desc: Kuk Po village, located on the remote border between Hong Kong and the Chinese mainland, was once known as a ghost village since the 1970s, when residents moved away for urban life. . Once a vibrant Hakka community with over 500 residents a century ago, Kuk Po village turned into a no man’s land in the 70s, marked by decaying mansions and abandoned ancestral homes. This stark transformation pushed 73-year-old villager Ho Sui Ting to embark on an ambitious project - to revive the empty village. . But it’s a tough job for just one man, but he insists. Ho was the very first batch of villagers to start the project, restoring the vegetation on poor soil and rebuilding the stonewall more than a century ago. He also built a “museum,” collecting artifacts that reflect the Hakka community's collective memories. . “Some people think I’m strange, like the foolish old man (Yugong) in the well-known Chinese fable who moved mountains?,” said Ho. . His works inspired other villagers and even residents from nearby semi-empty islands to join the revival, including Gen Z member Lilian. Lilian did not grow up in the village, but her family has deep roots in Kuk Po. She returned during the COVID pandemic to escape the chaos and started to fall in love with her hometown. She then collaborated with a university to restore her ancestral home, which was built a century ago. . This episode begins with Ho reciting a poem about the journey home, followed by villagers from different generations as they faced the decline of their once-thriving community. How can they revive Kuk Po and restore its spirit and legacy to prevent it from fading into oblivion.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十六集：肖春生公司的核心技術被洩漏
programme.desc: 肖春生的女兒肖蓓蓓生日，肖春生邀請葉國華和賀紅玲一起來吃飯。葉國華和賀紅玲回家卻大吵一架，葉國華認為賀紅玲還想著肖春生。面對猜忌懷疑的葉國華，賀紅玲終於忍受不了，她要求離婚。肖春生公司的核心技術被黑子洩漏給李上游。葉國華的公司改而和李上游的公司合作.

programme.desc: 港隊霹靂舞隊不再限於街頭文化，而是直接打進奧運及全運舞台，並於剛過去的全運賽事中取得男子組總排名第五名的驕人成績。. 香港手球隊代表兼物理治療師葉冠英（大英）「捨手取腳」，憑著球場上的爆發力，迎接霹靂舞速度與智慧的考驗。大英跟教練學習搖滾步,排腿,定格等基本動作後即需接受比拼。他能否在短短1分鐘內編出自己的舞步，透過舞步展現自己的故事.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈: 狂喜之詩中國愛樂樂團音樂會

programme.sub-title: 第五集 - 許靖韻、黎展峯、艾妮｜中華食材詩中尋！
programme.desc: 第五集星級嘉賓許靖韻、黎展峯和艾妮，三位同門師姐弟妹齊齊分享在大江南北遊歷的美好回憶。問答環節不單止有歷史地理、現代文學，想不到還有軍事設備、明朝稅制的難題！今次還會帶大家到訪雲南大理白族周城村，入面世代流傳的傳統技藝你又知多少？中國素來民以食為天，三位嘉賓又能否成功分辨哪些是原產自中國的食材？誰有把握從名詩中找出隱藏其中的食物呢？記得留意今集《中華知識王2》！. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：許靖韻、黎展峯、艾妮. #中華知識王2#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#許靖韻#黎展峯#艾妮#雲南大理古城#白族周城村#中國原產食材.

programme.title: 十二封信
programme.desc: 1991年，葉海棠和唐亦尋發現「午夜」、「貓咪」、「特殊信紙」是觸發郵筒通信的條件，並用遺書的信紙嘗試回信。2026年，沈程與余念竟真的收到了來自過去的回信，確認了跨時空通信的真實性，決定聯手引導過去的葉海棠。與此同時，那封最初引發風波的「情書」被發現字跡與唐亦尋一模一樣，暗示它可能來自未來的他自己.

programme.title: 傷健同行小僱事
programme.desc: 作為香港經濟支柱之一的零售業，近年漸見殘疾僱員的身影在其中。在競爭激烈的零售市場當中，不難發現『講金又講心』的溫暖故事。. 售賣咖啡產品的小型連鎖店老闆Gigi，十多年來堅持聘請殘疾人士為員工。. 品牌目前有四間實體店舖，員工人數不多，但其中一半為殘疾人士。當中聾人咖啡師，以及被確診患有專注力不足的烘焙師，除專注在本身的崗位，Gigi近年更安排他們在店舖以及市集擔任銷售員，訓練他們多接觸群眾，練習與人溝通、管理等技巧，帶望他們在能在日後的求職路上更有競爭力。. Gigi更經常鼓勵、安排員工參與本地及國內外的手冲咖啡及烘焙比賽，期望可在小小的咖啡零售店以外，帶領員工踏上更廣闊的舞台，拓闊視野。. 成立二十多年的社企公司，目前有超過七成的員工為精神病康復者。公司旗下業務眾多，零售業為當中主要業務之一，轄下除擁有售賣復康用品的自家品牌店及餐廳，近年更開始跟慈善基金合作，開展便利店的業務。. 曾患思覺失調的康復者，以及患有阿氏保加症的員工，分別擔任便利店店員以及送貨員，其家人、上司、社工等的輔導跟協助，成為他們最強的後盾。. 本集幾位於零售業打拼的殘疾人士，在求職及工作的路上，透過自身努力突破障礙，勇敢挑戰自我.

programme.desc: 港隊霹靂舞隊不再限於街頭文化，而是直接打進奧運及全運舞台，並於剛過去的全運賽事中取得男子組總排名第五名的驕人成績。. 香港手球隊代表兼物理治療師葉冠英（大英）「捨手取腳」，憑著球場上的爆發力，迎接霹靂舞速度與智慧的考驗。大英跟教練學習搖滾步,排腿,定格等基本動作後即需接受比拼。他能否在短短1分鐘內編出自己的舞步，透過舞步展現自己的故事.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.desc: Kuk Po village, located on the remote border between Hong Kong and the Chinese mainland, was once known as a ghost village since the 1970s, when residents moved away for urban life. . Once a vibrant Hakka community with over 500 residents a century ago, Kuk Po village turned into a no man’s land in the 70s, marked by decaying mansions and abandoned ancestral homes. This stark transformation pushed 73-year-old villager Ho Sui Ting to embark on an ambitious project - to revive the empty village. . But it’s a tough job for just one man, but he insists. Ho was the very first batch of villagers to start the project, restoring the vegetation on poor soil and rebuilding the stonewall more than a century ago. He also built a “museum,” collecting artifacts that reflect the Hakka community's collective memories. . “Some people think I’m strange, like the foolish old man (Yugong) in the well-known Chinese fable who moved mountains?,” said Ho. . His works inspired other villagers and even residents from nearby semi-empty islands to join the revival, including Gen Z member Lilian. Lilian did not grow up in the village, but her family has deep roots in Kuk Po. She returned during the COVID pandemic to escape the chaos and started to fall in love with her hometown. She then collaborated with a university to restore her ancestral home, which was built a century ago. . This episode begins with Ho reciting a poem about the journey home, followed by villagers from different generations as they faced the decline of their once-thriving community. How can they revive Kuk Po and restore its spirit and legacy to prevent it from fading into oblivion.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 鮮豔的顏色層次、衝擊的味覺體驗，泰菜的魅力席捲亞洲。主廚Art Sinlaparkorn在本集會分享泰國料理中酸、辣、鹹、甜的精妙平衡，以及自己的烹飪哲學。兒時受祖母啟發，令他醉心於泰國料理的藝術，踏上成為廚師之路。Chef Art將從小到大嘗遍的泰國地道風味，直接複製到香港；更邀請主持Andy Dark細嚐青木瓜沙律、醉貓炒河、泰式椰子煎餅等街頭美食。. 離開家鄉追隨夢想，Chef Art幸運地在香港遇上他的「另一半」。他們與一班同鄉好友，慢慢在香港建立另一個「家」.

programme.title: 再登地球之巔
programme.desc: 面對極寒、極旱、極缺氧、極強紫外線的大自然，青藏高原上的生命演化出了怎樣獨特的形態？在第二次青藏科考中，科學家搜尋世界級的九大完整垂直自然帶、採集隱密的微生物聚落、探索最俱生物多樣性之一的神秘地帶、追蹤珍稀物種黑頸鶴的遷徙路線。科學家期待揭開青藏高原鮮為人知的「生命之極」.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：奧菲歐與尤麗迪采
programme.sub-title: 奧菲歐與尤麗迪采 (下集)
programme.desc: 本劇講述奧菲歐痛失愛妻尤麗迪采後，毅然闖入冥界，誓言帶回妻子。愛神賜予他救贖的機會，卻設下「不可回頭」的嚴苛條件。奧菲歐歷經怨靈阻攔、冥界幻景，終與尤麗迪采重逢，卻在返回人間的最後關頭，因妻子的悲傷質疑而絕望回首，導致永別。最終愛神為其深情所動，讓愛人重生，見證真愛超越生死。歌劇片段由香港非凡美樂提供。. 藝術總監：盧景文. 監製及導演：梁笑君. 指揮：杜洛沙. 演出：. 李卓麟. 金雅修. 沈喜詠. 鄧思寧、文浚彥. Rebaroque Orchestra. 非凡美樂合唱團.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：漫興樂想 爵士鋼琴家雷柏熹談即興功夫
programme.sub-title: 漫興樂想 爵士鋼琴家雷柏熹談即興功夫
programme.desc: 爵士樂與功夫，看似沒有關連，其實只不過藝術以不同型式的展現，而「即興」將兩者連繫起來。爵士樂講求樂手之間的互動即興，以音樂建構對話；武術則需要配合時機，身體與本能即興發揮，在實戰中與對手見招拆招。. 《演藝盛薈.開放舞台》搜羅了港大繆思樂季「漫興樂想」系列，以功夫為主題，由鋼琴家雷柏熹，聯同一眾樂手，合奏改編自李小龍經典功夫電影的爵士樂組曲。雷柏熹更邀請兩位武術大師，荷里活武術指導、印尼武術大師戴志良及葉問詠春傳人楊永勣，一同分享爵士樂與武術格鬥的兩者的共通之處：即興，暢談箇中玄機。三位亦會即場獻技，展現爵士樂與武術的哲學和真功夫。節目片段由港大繆思樂季攝製及提供。. 音樂. Patrick Lui 雷柏熹, piano & host. Nate Wong 黃彥康, drums. Wong Tak Chung 黃德聰, bass. Paulo Levi 利保羅, tenor saxophone. Hwasung Yoon, trumpet. Tomomi Taniguchi 谷口知巳, trombone. 功夫. Evan Tai 戴志良, Silat. Jerry Yeung 楊永勣, Ving Tsun.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 今集講述有一位小鄰居覺得爸爸媽媽，甚至連婆婆都不疼愛她。因為媽媽不給零用錢，婆婆也不理她，感到失去原有的「福利」。到底「福利」是不是應該永遠不變呢？. 所以，貓頭鷹博士登場，引用《基本法》第一百四十五條，帶領芊穎重新思考。究竟這次是父母真的不再疼愛她，還是一場誤會？. 《基本法》第一百四十五條:. 香港特別行政區政府在原有社會福利制度的基礎上，根據經濟條件和社會需要，自行制定其發展、改進的政策。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 從黃海之濱的「海上牧場」到南海沿線的「海上森林」。從「東方天鵝王國」到海南的綠肺新生。這些都見證生態重煥生機。大天鵝重返榮成海灣，白鷺定居陵水紅樹林，這些大自然的歸客見證生態重生。海上森林築起生態屏障，海洋牧場變身綠色糧倉。當珊瑚、海草、紅樹林在此交會，大自然正為中國的海灣治理頒發藍色勳章.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 一個以瀕危動物為靈感的香港原創手袋品牌，憑着生動造型與實用設計，逐步走向國際市場。人氣提升的同時，品牌亦面對山寨產品湧現，影響銷售及品牌形象。. 本集將了解品牌如何透過外觀設計註冊，守護創意成果；又如何憑藉法律保障，維持產品獨特性，讓更多原創動物造型手袋得以安心誕生，繼續在世界各地展現香港設計的魅力.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星願》以星辰為見證，講述高原上文化守護與文明追溯的故事。芒康鹽井，格松江措一家依藏曆守千年鹽田，老房變家庭博物館，讓古法製鹽活態傳承。古格王朝遺址，宗同昌為攝影集重返，與守護十年的巴次共探王朝興衰.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
十二封信
programme.desc: 1991年，二人追查神秘老人和郵筒的來歷。唐亦尋從想將葉海棠關進精神病院的父親手中救出她，兩個孤兒決定結為家人，共同生活。9月23日，信中預言的「龍吸水」異象成真，他們徹底相信了未來通信。2026年，余念因尋父失敗而崩潰大哭，沈程卻在此時接到通知：他的母親葉海棠找到了.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
周末大電影：守島人
programme.desc: 故事講述王繼才在開山島上守島衛國32年的感人事跡.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 卡巴迪運動起源於南亞，為刺激版「麻鷹抓雞仔」，需具備力量、敏捷反應和團隊合作精神，香港女子卡巴迪隊蓄勢待發，劍指六月舉辦的第二屆東亞盃女子卡巴迪錦標賽。. 歌手黎展峯（Andy）為跑步愛好者，跟著港隊投入卡巴迪正式訓練，學習步法、捉腳、漁網式防守等主要技巧，最後更與港隊成員來一場正式的卡巴迪比賽！Andy能否展現麻鷹的姿態，捉到最多的雞仔.
